AD.summary_zh: 國人赴安道爾觀光旅遊時須注意提高警覺,以免財物遭扒竊,並請於赴歐洲旅遊前務必購買海外急難救助及足額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間內自身的安全與權益;行前並與親友或雇主洽妥國際匯款方式,以備即時獲得濟助。旅遊期間務必小心自身護照、身分證件及錢財,倘護照或錢財遭竊,請立即向當地警察局報案。
AD.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling to Andorra for tourism should stay alert to avoid pickpocketing. Before travelling to Europe, they should be sure to purchase overseas emergency assistance and adequate medical insurance to protect their safety and rights during the trip. Before departure, they should also arrange with relatives, friends or employers a way of receiving international remittances so that they can obtain help promptly. During the trip, take care of your passport, identity documents and money; if your passport or money is stolen, report it to the local police immediately.

AE.summary_zh: 美國及以色列於本(2026)年2月28日對伊朗發動空襲,伊朗隨即進行反擊,攻擊美軍在中東地區軍事基地,範圍並已擴至區域多國民間設施,3月1日伊朗並對阿聯阿布達比、杜拜等地發動無人機攻擊。因中東區域安全情勢急劇惡化,為確保國人安全,外交部業於3月1日將阿聯全境之旅遊警示自黃色調整為「橙色」。外交部呼籲國人密切注意區域情勢發展,旅阿聯國人務請提高警覺,留意阿聯政府資訊,以維護個人權益及生命財產安全。
AE.summary_en: On 28 February this year (2026), the United States and Israel launched air strikes on Iran. Iran immediately retaliated, attacking US military bases in the Middle East, and the attacks have since extended to civilian facilities in several countries in the region. On 1 March, Iran also launched drone attacks on Abu Dhabi, Dubai and other places in the UAE. Because the security situation in the Middle East has deteriorated sharply, MOFA raised the travel alert for the whole of the UAE from yellow to "orange" on 1 March to ensure the safety of Taiwanese nationals. MOFA urges Taiwanese nationals to follow regional developments closely. Taiwanese nationals in the UAE should stay alert and heed information from the UAE government in order to protect their personal rights and their lives and property.

AF.summary_zh: 2024年12月21日「巴基斯坦塔利班運動」(Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan,TTP)突襲巴基斯坦西北部與阿富汗接壤之南瓦茲里斯坦縣(South Waziristan) 軍事哨所,造成16名巴國士兵喪生。巴國軍機旋於同月24日晚間空襲TTP營地所在之阿富汗東部帕克提卡省(Paktika),造成至少46人死亡,其中多數為婦女及兒童。阿富汗塔利班政權譴責巴國暴行,並於12月28日在巴基斯坦邊境據點進行反擊,造成數十人…
AF.summary_en: On 21 December 2024, the Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) attacked a military outpost in South Waziristan district in north-western Pakistan, on the border with Afghanistan, killing 16 Pakistani soldiers. On the evening of 24 December, Pakistani military aircraft struck TTP camps in Paktika province in eastern Afghanistan, killing at least 46 people, most of them women and children. The Afghan Taliban government condemned Pakistan's brutality and on 28 December retaliated against border posts on the Pakistani frontier, causing dozens of...

AG.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區6月至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),請國人赴當地商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災請依照當地政府指示避難,並聯繫我駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館。
AG.summary_en: June to November is hurricane season in the Caribbean. Taiwanese nationals travelling to the area on business or for tourism must keep checking the weather forecast at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, follow the instructions of the local government to take shelter and contact the Embassy of the Republic of China (Taiwan) in Saint Kitts and Nevis.

AI.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區6月至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),請國人赴當地商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災請依照當地政府指示避難,並聯繫我駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館。

AL.summary_zh: 我國人持中華民國(臺灣)護照(效期6個月以上)享有180天內免簽證入境觀光旅遊90天待遇,免簽證入境待遇係供短期觀光商旅之用,倘須工作應向阿爾巴尼亞當局申辦工作許可,並請留意切勿從事非法工作及違反當地法令。
AL.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals holding a Republic of China (Taiwan) passport valid for at least 6 months may enter Albania visa-free for tourism for up to 90 days within any 180-day period. Visa-free entry is intended for short-term tourism and business visits. Anyone who needs to work must apply to the Albanian authorities for a work permit. Do not engage in illegal work or violate local laws and regulations.

AM.summary_zh: 亞美尼亞政府已取消COVID-19疫情入境限制措施,惟因俄烏戰爭尚未結束,建議國人避免非必要旅行。
AM.summary_en: The Armenian government has lifted its COVID-19 entry restrictions, but because the Russia-Ukraine war has not yet ended, MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid non-essential travel.

AO.summary_zh: 非洲聯盟(African Union)下屬之非洲疾病管制暨預防中心(Africa CDC)於2026年5月23日警告,除剛果民主共和國與烏干達外,另有10個非洲國家面臨伊波拉病毒擴散風險,其中包含安哥拉。國人若在當地,應採取加強防護措施。欲查詢相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
AO.summary_en: On 23 May 2026, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) of the African Union warned that, in addition to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, 10 other African countries, including Angola, are at risk of the spread of the Ebola virus. Taiwanese nationals who are in Angola should take enhanced protective measures. For information on the outbreak and on infectious disease prevention and control, please see the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw ).

AR.summary_zh: 阿根廷政府要求所有非居民之外國人入境需出示足以支付在阿國停留期間醫療所須之有效保險資料。
AR.summary_en: The Argentine government requires all non-resident foreign nationals entering the country to present valid insurance documentation sufficient to cover the medical costs they may incur during their stay in Argentina.

AT.summary_zh: 國人來歐旅遊,常因護照與錢包放在一起保管遭竊,除了財物損失之外也造成後續旅遊行程延誤。另國人出國旅遊常有各種意想不到的情況發生,遇到生病或受傷時可能需要住院治療,由於遊客在奧地利自費醫療金額高昂,加護病房每日單價動輒高達數千歐元。
AT.summary_en: Taiwanese travellers in Europe often have their passports stolen because they are kept together with their wallets, which causes not only financial loss but also delays to the rest of the itinerary. Unexpected situations also often arise when Taiwanese nationals travel abroad, and illness or injury may require hospital treatment. Medical care paid out of pocket by visitors in Austria is very expensive, and the daily cost of an intensive care unit can easily reach several thousand euros.

AU.summary_zh: 澳洲雪梨熱門景點邦岱(Bondi)海灘2025年12月發生恐攻槍擊事件,造成多人傷亡,提醒國人旅澳期間提高警覺,嚴加注意人身安全,尤其在車站、商場等公共場所人潮聚集處。近期發生數起在主要城市市區華人遭澳洲青少年攻擊事件,夜間外出請留意周遭情況,人煙較稀少處,建議結伴同行。從事各項戶外或水上活動,請將安全納入考量,尤其在有潛在風險的海域。澳洲政府自2024年8月5日將澳洲「國家恐怖主義威脅等級」(National Terrorism T…
AU.summary_en: A terrorist shooting attack occurred in December 2025 at Bondi Beach, a popular attraction in Sydney, Australia, causing multiple casualties. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals travelling in Australia to stay alert and take great care for their personal safety, especially in crowded public places such as train stations and shopping centres. There have recently been several incidents in which Chinese people were attacked by Australian teenagers in the centres of major cities. When going out at night, be aware of your surroundings, and in sparsely populated places it is advisable to travel in company. When taking part in any outdoor or water activity, give due consideration to safety, especially in waters with potential risks. Since 5 August 2024, the Australian government has set the National Terrorism T...

AW.summary_zh: 荷蘭屬地阿魯巴已解除COVID-19防疫相關禁令,我國人可免簽赴該地旅遊,外交部建議國人出發前參考其政府旅遊網站最新規定(https://www.aruba.com)。
AW.summary_en: Aruba, a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, has lifted its COVID-19 prevention restrictions, and Taiwanese nationals may travel there visa-free. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to check the latest rules on the Aruban government's tourism website before departure (https://www.aruba.com).

AZ.summary_zh: 亞塞拜然政府已取消COVID-19疫情入境限制措施,惟因俄烏戰爭尚未結束,建議國人避免非必要旅行。
AZ.summary_en: The Azerbaijani government has lifted its COVID-19 entry restrictions, but because the Russia-Ukraine war has not yet ended, MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid non-essential travel.

BA.name_zh: 波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納
BA.summary_zh: 波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納(波赫)首都塞拉耶佛偷竊及劫案近來有上升趨勢,請赴波赫國人提高警覺,建議結伴同行並減少單獨外出,並妥善保管個人財物。
BA.summary_en: Theft and robbery have recently been rising in Sarajevo, the capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH). Taiwanese nationals travelling to BiH are asked to stay alert, to travel in company and avoid going out alone, and to keep their personal belongings safe.

BB.summary_zh: 加勒比海颶風季為每年6月至11月,高峰期為每年8月至10月。建議國人至巴貝多旅遊前應時刻關注天氣預報、飛機起降資訊並預作防災準備。
BB.summary_en: The Caribbean hurricane season runs from June to November each year, with the peak from August to October. Before travelling to Barbados, Taiwanese nationals are advised to keep checking the weather forecast and flight arrival and departure information, and to make disaster preparations in advance.

BD.summary_zh: 孟加拉2024年6月因民眾抗議引發大規模警民衝突,首都達卡(Dhaka)等重要城市尤為嚴重,情勢頗為嚴峻。目前當地緊張情勢已趨和緩,惟2026年上半年可能舉行全國大選,各方勢力競逐影響力,可能導致政局不穩,建議國人審慎考量前往之必要性,並請隨時留意局勢演變。
BD.summary_en: In June 2024, public protests in Bangladesh triggered large-scale clashes between citizens and police, which were especially severe in major cities such as the capital Dhaka, and the situation was quite serious. Tensions there have now eased, but national elections may be held in the first half of 2026, and competition among various forces for influence may lead to political instability. Taiwanese nationals are advised to consider carefully whether travel there is necessary, and to keep following developments in the situation.

BE.summary_zh: 比利時「國家危機中心」經研析整體安全威脅情勢,自2023年10月16日布魯塞爾市發生之恐攻事件(造成2名外籍人士死亡)後,截至2026年8月,比利時「威脅分析協調機構」(CUTA/OCAM)評估比國之整體安全威脅等級,仍維持在第3級:嚴重 (Severe/Grave) (由低至高共列4級),顯示潛在風險仍然存在。提醒國人旅比期間應隨時提高警覺,尤其在出入機場、車站、觀光景點及國際組織等敏感區域時,多加注意人身及財物安全。
BE.summary_en: Belgium's National Crisis Centre has analysed the overall security threat situation. Since the terrorist attack in Brussels on 16 October 2023 (which killed 2 foreign nationals), and as of August 2026, Belgium's Coordination Unit for Threat Analysis (CUTA/OCAM) continues to assess the country's overall security threat level at Level 3: Severe/Grave (on a scale of 4 levels from low to high), showing that the potential risk remains. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to stay alert at all times while travelling in Belgium, and to take extra care for their personal safety and belongings, especially when entering or leaving airports, train stations, tourist sites and sensitive areas such as international organisations.

BF.summary_zh: 2022年布國軍官Ibrahim Traoré上尉發動軍事政變成立過渡政府。由於臨時政府未能徹底解決武裝恐怖份子襲擊布國等問題,布國當前安全情勢堪憂;其境內武裝恐怖組織活躍,旅客恐遭綁架或攻擊,且當地仍有宵禁措施,近期應避免赴當地旅行。倘須前往布國,應避免步行或騎乘摩托車、攜帶貴重物品與處理金融事務,並將護照、現金和銀行卡分別保管,夜間也應避免外出。
BF.summary_en: In 2022, Burkinabe army officer Captain Ibrahim Traore staged a military coup and established a transitional government. Because the interim government has been unable to fully resolve problems such as armed terrorist attacks in Burkina Faso, the country's current security situation is of grave concern. Armed terrorist organisations are active within the country, travellers may be kidnapped or attacked, and curfew measures remain in place, so travel there should be avoided for the time being. If you must go to Burkina Faso, avoid travelling on foot or by motorcycle, carrying valuables and handling financial matters, keep your passport, cash and bank cards separately, and avoid going out at night.

BG.summary_zh: 保加利亞政府已取消COVID-19入境檢疫相關措施,詳情可參考下列網站:mfa.bg/en/customnews/main/24737。
BG.summary_en: The Bulgarian government has lifted its COVID-19 entry quarantine measures. For details, see the following website: mfa.bg/en/customnews/main/24737.

BH.summary_zh: 美國及以色列於2026年2月28日對伊朗發動空襲,伊朗隨即進行反擊,攻擊美軍在中東地區軍事基地,範圍並已擴至區域多國民間設施,美伊雖曾於本年6月17日達成停火協議,然自7月起雙方又再發生軍事衝突,伊朗並於本年7月9日起斷續對週邊國家/地區及巴林境內相關設施發動攻擊。鑒於中東區域情勢仍持續動盪,為確保國人安全,巴林全境之旅遊警示維持為「橙色」。
BH.summary_en: On 28 February 2026, the United States and Israel launched air strikes on Iran, and Iran immediately retaliated, attacking US military bases in the Middle East; the attacks have since extended to civilian facilities in several countries in the region. Although the US and Iran reached a ceasefire agreement on 17 June this year, military clashes between the two sides resumed from July, and from 9 July this year Iran has intermittently attacked neighbouring countries/regions and related facilities in Bahrain. Because the situation in the Middle East remains turbulent, the travel alert for the whole of Bahrain remains "orange" to ensure the safety of Taiwanese nationals.

BI.summary_zh: 非洲疾病管制暨預防中心(Africa CDC)於2026年5月23日提出警告,除剛果民主共和國及烏干達外,蒲隆地等10國亦面臨伊波拉病毒擴散風險,國人若在當地,應採取加強防護措施並儘速離境。欲查詢蒲隆地相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
BI.summary_en: On 23 May 2026, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) warned that, in addition to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, 10 countries including Burundi are at risk of the spread of the Ebola virus. Taiwanese nationals who are in Burundi should take enhanced protective measures and leave the country as soon as possible. For information on the outbreak and on infectious disease prevention and control in Burundi, please see the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw ).

BJ.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
BJ.summary_en: China's "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" takes effect on 1 July 2026. It states that "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine China's ethnic unity and progress or engage in ethnic separatism will be held legally liable in accordance with the law", an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction that threatens foreign nationals outside China. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying overseas, in order to protect their own rights and personal safety.

BL.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區6月至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),法屬聖巴瑟米領土較小,大雨恐造成土石流,切斷周遭社區與外界交通聯繫,請國人赴當地商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災請依照當地政府指示避難,並聯繫我駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館提供必要協助。
BL.summary_en: June to November is hurricane season in the Caribbean. Saint Barthelemy, a French territory, is small, and heavy rain may cause landslides that cut surrounding communities off from the outside world. Taiwanese nationals travelling there on business or for tourism must keep checking the weather forecast at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, follow the instructions of the local government to take shelter and contact the Embassy of the Republic of China (Taiwan) in Saint Kitts and Nevis for the assistance needed.

BM.summary_zh: 百慕達政府宣布自2022年11月14日起,取消原 COVID-19相關國際旅客入境旅遊檢疫措施。
BM.summary_en: The Bermuda government announced that, from 14 November 2022, it has lifted the COVID-19 entry quarantine measures for international visitors.

BN.summary_zh: 填寫電子入境登記卡(E-Arrival Card Registration):

BO.summary_zh: 玻利維亞境內持續傳出登革熱、屈公病、茲卡病毒、鉤端螺旋體病、黃熱病、狂犬病及瘧疾疫情,並有死亡病例通報,外交部提醒國人赴玻國前採取適當防蚊及防疫措施,孕婦或計劃懷孕之婦女應評估宜否前往;倘規劃前往高海拔地區(La Paz及Uyuni等觀光勝地海拔均超過3,500公尺),須嚴防高山症,有心血管疾病國人宜先經醫師評估後再行前往;擬前往黃熱病疫區者,宜事先注射黃熱病疫苗,訪玻前建議購買適當醫療及旅遊平安險。
BO.summary_en: Outbreaks of dengue, chikungunya, Zika virus, leptospirosis, yellow fever, rabies and malaria continue to be reported in Bolivia, with deaths reported. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals to take appropriate mosquito-prevention and disease-prevention measures before travelling to Bolivia. Pregnant women, or women planning to become pregnant, should assess whether it is advisable to go. If you plan to go to high-altitude areas (tourist destinations such as La Paz and Uyuni are all above 3,500 metres), you must guard against altitude sickness, and those with cardiovascular disease should be assessed by a doctor before going. Those planning to visit yellow fever areas should receive the yellow fever vaccine beforehand. Before visiting Bolivia, it is advisable to purchase appropriate medical and travel accident insurance.

Taiwanese nationals travelling there on business or for tourism must keep checking the weather forecast at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, follow the instructions of the local government to take shelter and contact the Embassy of the Republic of China (Taiwan) in Saint Kitts and Nevis for the assistance needed.

BR.summary_zh: 巴西國家衛生監督局(ANVISA)公告,所有旅客入境巴西,無須出示接種新冠肺炎疫苗證明或COVID-19抗原檢測(Antigeno)或核酸(RT-PCR)檢驗陰性證明。

areas.area_zh: 巴西東南部(聖保羅州、里約州、聖靈州、大礦州)、南部(巴拉納州、聖卡達莉納州、南大河州)及南大草原州
areas.area_en: Brazil - Southeast Region (MG、ES、RJ、SP)、South Region(PR、SC、RS) and the state of Mato Grosso do Sul(MS)
areas.summary_zh: 巴西東南部登革熱疫情嚴重,外交部提醒國人旅巴期間注意相關防護措施,倘有發燒、頭痛及全身痠痛等疑似登革熱症狀請儘快就醫。
areas.summary_en: Dengue outbreaks are severe in south-eastern Brazil. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals travelling in Brazil to take the relevant protective measures, and to seek medical attention promptly if they develop symptoms suggestive of dengue, such as fever, headache and body aches.

BR.summary_en: According to an announcement by Brazil's National Health Surveillance Agency (ANVISA), travellers entering Brazil are not required to present proof of COVID-19 vaccination or a negative COVID-19 antigen (Antigeno) or nucleic acid (RT-PCR) test result.

BS.summary_zh: 巴哈馬政府宣布自2022年9月20日起,取消原COVID-19相關國際旅客入境旅遊檢疫措施。
BS.summary_en: The Bahamas government announced that, from 20 September 2022, it has lifted the COVID-19 entry quarantine measures for international visitors.

BT.summary_zh: 不丹深處喜馬拉雅山區內陸,對外往來之國際民航班機有限,且易因天候影響而延誤或取消,國人前往當地旅行,應隨時注意航空公司相關訊息。
BT.summary_en: Bhutan is landlocked deep in the Himalayas, and international commercial flights to and from the country are limited and easily delayed or cancelled by weather. Taiwanese nationals travelling there should keep checking the relevant airline information.

BW.summary_zh: 波札那首都嘉伯隆(Gaborone)、法蘭西斯頓(Francistown)及馬恩(Maun)等城鎮暴力犯罪時有所聞,如入室搶劫、劫車及幫派火拚等。建議赴訪國人在商店、餐廳等公共場所避免穿戴貴重飾品、亦勿顯露大筆現金或單獨行動,隨時提高警覺以維自身及財物安全。
BW.summary_en: Violent crime, such as home-invasion robberies, carjackings and gang shootouts, is reported from time to time in towns including the capital Gaborone, Francistown and Maun. Taiwanese nationals visiting Botswana are advised to avoid wearing valuable jewellery in public places such as shops and restaurants, not to show large amounts of cash, and not to go about alone, and to stay alert at all times to protect their own safety and belongings.

BY.summary_zh: 白俄羅斯與中國簽有司法互助條約及引渡協定,提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
BY.summary_en: Belarus has signed a judicial assistance treaty and an extradition agreement with China. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying overseas, in order to protect their own rights and personal safety.

BZ.summary_zh: 貝里斯政府自114年3月1日起調整經Philip S.W. Goldson國際機場入出境管制措施規定,所有旅客須於入出境貝國24小時前上網完成填寫移民及海關申報表格( https://belizetravel.immigration.gov.bz/Belize_Digital_Forms/ ),填寫完畢後須保留QR Code截圖或列印紙本確認書,於通關時出示,原則將不再透過紙本方式申報。
BZ.summary_en: From 1 March 2025 (ROC Year 114), the Belize government has adjusted its entry and exit control measures at Philip S.W. Goldson International Airport. All travellers must complete the online immigration and customs declaration form ( https://belizetravel.immigration.gov.bz/Belize_Digital_Forms/ ) at least 24 hours before entering or leaving Belize. After completing it, keep a screenshot of the QR Code or print the paper confirmation and show it at clearance. In principle, paper declarations will no longer be accepted.

CA.summary_zh: 加拿大地區近日持續發生多起有關電話、簡訊、求職及網路購物等詐騙案件,受害人數逐年攀升。常見詐騙手法包括:佯稱加拿大稅務局(CRA)通知退稅或欠稅、冒充移民局或警察單位、偽稱快遞包裹未取及涉及求職、租屋或冒充中共警察等詐騙案件,提醒旅加民眾應多加留意詐騙案件,避免造成重大財務損失及個資外流風險。

areas.area_zh: 加拿大緬尼托巴省
areas.summary_zh: 加拿大緬尼托巴省於本(2025)年6月23日宣布解除野火延燒之緊急狀態,並於6月26日宣布解除該省大部份地區之旅遊禁令,惟部份區域(請參考緬省官方網站: www.gov.mb.ca/conservation_fire/Fire-Maps/fireview/fireview_map.html )仍有野火延燒情形 。外交部提醒國人倘前往緬省旅遊,仍宜先查明目的地最新資訊,同時注意自身安全並避免前往災區。
areas.summary_en: On 23 June this year (2025), Manitoba, Canada, announced the end of the state of emergency for the spreading wildfires, and on 26 June announced the lifting of the travel ban for most of the province. However, wildfires are still burning in some areas (please see the Manitoba government website: www.gov.mb.ca/conservation_fire/Fire-Maps/fireview/fireview_map.html ). MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals who travel to Manitoba to still check the latest information on their destination first, to look after their own safety and to avoid disaster areas.

CA.summary_en: Canada has recently seen a continuing series of scams by telephone, text message, job offers and online shopping, with the number of victims rising year by year. Common scam methods include: falsely claiming to be the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) notifying of a tax refund or tax owed, impersonating immigration authorities or the police, falsely claiming that a courier parcel has not been collected, scams involving job-hunting or rental housing, and impersonating Chinese Communist police. Taiwanese nationals travelling in Canada are reminded to be alert to scams to avoid serious financial loss and the risk of personal data leakage.

CD.summary_zh: 世界衛生組織(WHO)於2026年5月17日正式宣布,剛果民主共和國之伊波拉病毒感染疫情構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(Public Health Emergency of International Concern, PHEIC)」,國人若在當地,應採取加強防護措施並儘速離境。欲查詢剛果民主共和國相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
CD.summary_en: On 17 May 2026, the World Health Organization (WHO) formally declared the Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo a "Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)". Taiwanese nationals who are in the country should take enhanced protective measures and leave as soon as possible. For information on the outbreak and on infectious disease prevention and control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, please see the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw ).

CF.summary_zh: 非洲疾病管制暨預防中心(Africa CDC)於2026年5月23日提出警告,除剛果民主共和國及烏干達外,中非共和國等10國亦面臨伊波拉病毒擴散風險,國人若在當地,應採取加強防護措施並儘速離境。欲查詢中非共和國相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
CF.summary_en: On 23 May 2026, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) warned that, in addition to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, 10 countries including the Central African Republic are at risk of the spread of the Ebola virus. Taiwanese nationals who are in the Central African Republic should take enhanced protective measures and leave the country as soon as possible. For information on the outbreak and on infectious disease prevention and control in the Central African Republic, please see the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw ).

CG.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人,且剛果支持「一中原則」,與中國已簽署「刑事司法互助協定」及「引渡協定」,中國有權向該國申請法律協助或引渡逃犯。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
CG.summary_en: China's "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" takes effect on 1 July 2026. It states that "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine China's ethnic unity and progress or engage in ethnic separatism will be held legally liable in accordance with the law", an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction that threatens foreign nationals outside China. In addition, the Republic of the Congo supports the "One China principle" and has signed a "Criminal Judicial Assistance Agreement" and an "Extradition Agreement" with China, so China is entitled to request legal assistance from, or the extradition of fugitives by, that country. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying overseas, in order to protect their own rights and personal safety.

CH.summary_zh: 赴歐旅遊國人行前務必購妥海外急難救助及足額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間自身安全及權益。提醒國人旅遊期間將錢包及護照分開保管,避免同時遭竊;前往當地著名景點或人潮眾多場合,亦請隨時留意自身財物及安全。
CH.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling to Europe must purchase overseas emergency assistance and adequate medical insurance before departure to protect their safety and rights during the trip. They are reminded to keep their wallets and passports separately during the trip so that both are not stolen at the same time, and to keep a close watch on their belongings and personal safety at well-known attractions and in crowded places.

CI.summary_zh: 入境象國需出示已接種黃熱病疫苗之國際預防接種證明書(黃皮書);另象國為瘧疾及登革熱疫區,來象國人應攜帶並使用適當防蚊用品,如政府機關核可含DEET(敵避)、Picaridin(派卡瑞丁)或IR-3535(伊默克)等有效成分之防蚊藥劑(兒童建議使用濃度15%以下產品)。欲查詢象牙海岸相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。

areas.area_zh: 象牙海岸北部及西部邊境地區
areas.area_en: Northern and western border areas of Cote d'Ivoire
areas.summary_zh: 入境象國需出示已接種黃熱病疫苗之國際預防接種證明書(黃皮書);另象國為瘧疾及登革熱疫區,來象國人應攜帶並使用適當防蚊用品,如政府機關核可含DEET(敵避)、Picaridin(派卡瑞丁)或IR-3535(伊默克)等有效成分之防蚊藥劑(兒童建議使用濃度15%以下產品)。欲查詢象牙海岸相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
areas.summary_en: Entry into Cote d'Ivoire requires an International Certificate of Vaccination (yellow card) showing yellow fever vaccination. Cote d'Ivoire is also a malaria and dengue endemic area, so Taiwanese nationals visiting should bring and use appropriate mosquito repellent, such as government-approved repellents containing effective ingredients like DEET, Picaridin or IR-3535 (for children, products with a concentration of 15% or less are recommended). For information on the outbreak and on infectious disease prevention and control in Cote d'Ivoire, please see the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw ).

CI.summary_en: Entry into Cote d'Ivoire requires an International Certificate of Vaccination (yellow card) showing yellow fever vaccination. Cote d'Ivoire is also a malaria and dengue endemic area, so Taiwanese nationals visiting should bring and use appropriate mosquito repellent, such as government-approved repellents containing effective ingredients like DEET, Picaridin or IR-3535 (for children, products with a concentration of 15% or less are recommended). For information on the outbreak and on infectious disease prevention and control in Cote d'Ivoire, please see the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw ).

CK.summary_zh: 庫克群島政府已取消COVID-19入境檢疫相關措施,倘入境後發現感染COVID-19,建議自我隔離7天,請參閱官方網站: https://www.health.gov.ck/covid19/ 。
CK.summary_en: The Cook Islands government has lifted its COVID-19 entry quarantine measures. If you test positive for COVID-19 after entering, you are advised to self-isolate for 7 days; please see the official website: https://www.health.gov.ck/covid19/ .

CL.summary_zh: 近期智利首都地區及機場附近公路頻傳「持槍劫車或假車禍行搶事件」,國人自行駕車時請務必提高警覺並注意可疑來車;觀光地區屢見計程車司機詐騙遊客車資,提醒國人在智旅遊期間及往返機場務必使用合法叫車平台,並留意實際刷卡金額。
CL.summary_en: Armed carjackings and staged-car-accident robberies have recently been frequently reported on roads in the Chilean capital region and near the airport. Taiwanese nationals who drive themselves must stay alert and watch for suspicious vehicles. Taxi drivers in tourist areas are often found cheating visitors on fares, so Taiwanese nationals are reminded to use only legitimate ride-hailing platforms during their stay in Chile and for trips to and from the airport, and to check the actual amount charged to their card.

CM.summary_zh: 喀麥隆部分地區存在恐怖主義和暴力犯罪風險,請審慎評估行程安全。

areas.area_zh: 喀麥隆 - 北部極北省、北省及東省接近中非地區、西北省、西南省(包括Bakassi半島)
areas.area_en: Republic of Cameroon - Extreme Nord、Nord、Adamaoua、Est、Bakassi de Sud-Ouest
areas.summary_zh: 喀麥隆極北省存在恐怖主義和暴力犯罪風險;西北省及西南省持續發生政府軍與分離主義武裝衝突並伴隨綁架、道路封鎖及暴力事件;東省因鄰近中非共和國,受邊境難民影響,治安及社會穩定度較低,請審慎評估行程安全。
areas.summary_en: There are risks of terrorism and violent crime in Cameroon's Far North Region. In the North-West and South-West Regions, armed clashes between government forces and separatists continue, accompanied by kidnappings, roadblocks and violence. The East Region, being close to the Central African Republic and affected by refugees at the border, has relatively poor public security and social stability. Please assess the safety of your itinerary carefully.

CM.summary_en: There are risks of terrorism and violent crime in parts of Cameroon. Please assess the safety of your itinerary carefully.

CN.summary_zh: 陸委會自 2024 年 6 月 27 日起將中國大陸旅遊警示調升為「橙色」燈號，建議國人避免非必要旅行（中共發布「懲獨 22 條」意見，嚴重威脅國人赴陸人身安全）。
CN.summary_en: Since 27 June 2024 the Mainland Affairs Council has rated mainland China Orange: avoid non-essential travel (following Beijing's "22 guidelines" on punishing Taiwan independence).

CO.summary_zh: 哥國對一般旅客無特殊防疫規定,惟要求自安哥拉、剛果共和國、烏干達、巴西入境哥國之旅客須出示黃熱病疫苗接種證明,請注意事先備妥,以免入境受阻。
CO.summary_en: Colombia has no special disease-prevention requirements for general travellers, but travellers entering Colombia from Angola, the Republic of the Congo, Uganda and Brazil are required to present proof of yellow fever vaccination. Please prepare it in advance to avoid being refused entry.

CR.summary_zh: 哥斯大黎加近期強盜及兇殺案件呈現上升趨勢,其中首都聖荷西市(San José)、太平洋岸及加勒比海岸城市治安持續惡化,提醒前往哥國旅遊時應國人注意自身安全,保持警戒,並避免單獨行動及夜晚外出。
CR.summary_en: Robbery and homicide cases have recently been rising in Costa Rica, and public security continues to deteriorate in the capital San Jose, and in cities on the Pacific and Caribbean coasts. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Costa Rica are reminded to look after their own safety, stay alert, and avoid going out alone or at night.

CU.summary_zh: 古巴觀光部於2025年4月7日公告電子簽證(eVisa-Cuba)入境實施方案,宣布自同年7月1日起全面實施電子簽證入境措施,現行核發之入境觀光卡(Tarjeta de turista)有效期限至2025年6月30日止。
CU.summary_en: On 7 April 2025, Cuba's Ministry of Tourism announced the implementation plan for entry with an electronic visa (eVisa-Cuba), declaring that electronic visa entry will be fully implemented from 1 July of the same year. The tourist cards currently issued (Tarjeta de turista) remain valid until 30 June 2025.

CV.summary_zh: 請國人在規劃維德角行程時,仍事先洽詢航空公司及參考國際航空運輸協會網頁資訊( https:// www.iatatravelcentre.com/world.php ),以瞭解轉機及入境有否最新的規定(也包含天候異常現象是否影響航班運作等情況),旅行期間請隨時注意個人安全與衛生健康。
CV.summary_en: When planning a trip to Cape Verde, Taiwanese nationals are asked to still check in advance with the airline and consult the International Air Transport Association (IATA) website ( https:// www.iatatravelcentre.com/world.php ) to learn of the latest rules for transit and entry (including whether abnormal weather is affecting flight operations). During the trip, keep paying attention to your personal safety and health.

CW.summary_zh: 荷蘭屬地古拉索已解除COVID-19防疫相關禁令,我國人可免簽赴該地旅遊,外交部建議國人出發前參考其政府旅遊網站最新規定(https://www.curacao.com)。
CW.summary_en: Curacao, a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, has lifted its COVID-19 prevention restrictions, and Taiwanese nationals may travel there visa-free. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to check the latest rules on the Curacao government's tourism website before departure (https://www.curacao.com).

CY.summary_zh: 賽普勒斯政府已取消COVID-19入境檢疫相關措施,詳情請參考賽國旅遊部網站: www.tourism.gov.cy。
CY.summary_en: The Cyprus government has lifted its COVID-19 entry quarantine measures. For details, please see the website of the Cyprus Deputy Ministry of Tourism: www.tourism.gov.cy.

CZ.summary_zh: 赴捷克旅遊應注意事項:
CZ.summary_en: Points to note when travelling to the Czech Republic:

DE.summary_zh: 2024年12月20日德國中部馬德堡(Magdeburg)聖誕市集遭人駕車衝撞攻擊,造成5死200餘人輕重傷、8月23日德國西北威邦索林根市發生恐攻事件,造成3人死亡、8人受傷;2024年5月美國國務院亦曾調升對德旅遊警示至第2級「提高警覺」,擔心恐怖組織可能無預警在德國境內發動攻擊,目標可能是旅遊景點或交通樞紐等人潮聚集之處,請國人赴德務必提高警覺,注意周遭動態。
DE.summary_en: On 20 December 2024, a vehicle was driven into a Christmas market in Magdeburg, central Germany, in a ramming attack that killed 5 people and injured more than 200, some seriously. On 23 August, a terrorist attack in Solingen, North Rhine-Westphalia, in north-western Germany, killed 3 people and injured 8. In May 2024, the US Department of State also raised its travel advisory for Germany to Level 2, "Exercise Increased Caution", out of concern that terrorist organisations may carry out attacks in Germany without warning, possibly targeting tourist sites or transport hubs and other crowded places. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Germany must stay alert and pay attention to what is going on around them.

DJ.summary_zh: 中東地區之伊朗戰爭已連動吉布地及非洲之角區域安全情勢緊張,美國政府已針對吉國之美國大使館及Lemonnier美軍基地與其周邊區域發布安全威脅警訊,提醒其國人切勿靠近,並謹慎注意安全。
DJ.summary_en: The Iran war in the Middle East has heightened tensions in the security situation in Djibouti and the wider Horn of Africa. The US government has issued a security threat alert concerning the US Embassy in Djibouti, Camp Lemonnier and the surrounding areas, reminding its citizens not to approach them and to take care for their safety.

DK.summary_zh: 外交部提醒,國人赴丹麥旅遊護照及財物被扒案件頻仍,近來甚至偶有搶案發生,提醒國人務必提高警覺,留意證件及財物安全。丹麥扒竊作案迅速,常見地點及方式如下:
DK.summary_en: MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals that cases of passports and belongings being pickpocketed are frequent among those travelling in Denmark, and robberies have even occurred occasionally in recent times. Taiwanese nationals must stay alert and keep their documents and belongings safe. Pickpocketing in Denmark is carried out quickly; the common locations and methods are as follows:

areas.area_zh: 多明尼加
areas.summary_zh: 多明尼加政府已取消COVID-19入境檢疫相關措施。
areas.summary_en: The Dominican government has lifted its COVID-19 entry quarantine measures.

areas.area_zh: 多米尼克
areas.summary_zh: 加勒比海颶風季為每年6月至11月,高峰期為每年8月至10月。建議國人赴多米尼克旅遊前應時刻關注天氣預報、飛機起降資訊並預作防災準備。另當地公路部分路段陡坡、標示及照明不足,自駕或搭乘交通工具,建議多加留意道路狀況。
areas.summary_en: The Caribbean hurricane season runs from June to November each year, with the peak from August to October. Before travelling to Dominica, Taiwanese nationals are advised to keep checking the weather forecast and flight arrival and departure information, and to make disaster preparations in advance. In addition, some sections of local roads have steep slopes and inadequate signage and lighting, so when driving or travelling by other means of transport, it is advisable to pay extra attention to road conditions.

DZ.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人,且阿國支持「一中原則」,並與中國已簽署「刑事司法互助協定」及「引渡協定」,中國有權向該國申請法律協助或引渡逃犯。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
DZ.summary_en: China's "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" takes effect on 1 July 2026. It states that "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine China's ethnic unity and progress or engage in ethnic separatism will be held legally liable in accordance with the law", an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction that threatens foreign nationals outside China. In addition, Algeria supports the "One China principle" and has signed a "Criminal Judicial Assistance Agreement" and an "Extradition Agreement" with China, so China is entitled to request legal assistance from, or the extradition of fugitives by, that country. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying overseas, in order to protect their own rights and personal safety.

EC.summary_zh: 厄瓜多政府自2024年7月1日起取消中華人民共和國護照免簽入境待遇,並波及我國人亦須申辦簽證。在厄國政府恢復我國人免簽入境待遇前,提醒國人行前務必完成線上電子簽證申請。
EC.summary_en: From 1 July 2024, the Ecuadorian government cancelled visa-free entry for People's Republic of China passport holders, and this has also affected Taiwanese nationals, who now must apply for a visa. Until the Ecuadorian government restores visa-free entry for Taiwanese nationals, they are reminded to be sure to complete the online electronic visa application before departure.

EE.summary_zh: 赴歐旅遊國人行前務必購妥海外急難救助及全額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間自身安全及權益。提醒國人旅遊期間將錢包及護照分開保管,避免同時遭竊;前往當地著名景點或人潮眾多場合,亦請隨時留意自身財物及安全。
EE.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling to Europe must purchase overseas emergency assistance and full medical insurance before departure to protect their safety and rights during the trip. They are reminded to keep their wallets and passports separately during the trip so that both are not stolen at the same time, and to keep a close watch on their belongings and personal safety at well-known attractions and in crowded places.

EG.summary_zh: 中東情勢未見明顯改善,為確保國人安全,埃及之旅遊警示維持「橙色」,至埃及-西奈半島、埃及與利比亞及蘇丹邊境則維持紅色旅遊警示。

areas.area_zh: 埃及 - 西奈半島
areas.summary_zh: 埃及西奈半島北部及中部地區(特別是Arish、Rafah等地)局勢仍未穩定,仍有發生恐怖攻擊事件風險,建議國人避免前往(西奈半島南部觀光地區情勢相對穩定),建議擬赴該地旅遊國人審慎評估行程並注意自身安全。
areas.summary_en: The situation in northern and central parts of Egypt's Sinai Peninsula (especially Arish, Rafah and other places) remains unstable, and there is still a risk of terrorist attacks. Taiwanese nationals are advised to avoid going there (the tourist areas in the southern Sinai Peninsula are relatively stable), and those planning to travel to the area are advised to assess their itinerary carefully and look after their own safety.

areas.area_zh: 與利比亞及蘇丹邊境
areas.summary_zh: 由於利比亞及蘇丹情勢較不穩定,埃及將其與利比亞及蘇丹邊境區域劃為軍事管制區,建議國人請勿前往相關地區,以策安全。
areas.summary_en: Because the situations in Libya and Sudan are relatively unstable, Egypt has designated its border areas with Libya and Sudan as military restricted zones. Taiwanese nationals are advised not to go to those areas, for the sake of safety.

EG.summary_en: The situation in the Middle East has shown no clear improvement. To ensure the safety of Taiwanese nationals, the travel alert for Egypt remains "orange", while the red travel alert remains in place for the Sinai Peninsula in Egypt and for the borders between Egypt and Libya and Sudan.

ER.summary_zh: 外交部建議國人除非必要,暫時避免赴厄國商旅,另請國人在規劃前往厄國行程時,事先至外交部領事事務局網站( www.boca.gov.tw )或利用該局LINE官方帳號(ID:@boca.tw)完成「出國登錄」,另亦建議下載「旅外安全指南」APP(連結: https://k7h2b.app.goo.gl/LrS1 )可隨時查詢旅外安全相關資訊。並洽詢航空公司或參考國際航空運輸協會網頁資訊( www.iatatravelcentre.com…
ER.summary_en: MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid travelling to Eritrea for business or travel for the time being unless necessary. When planning a trip to Eritrea, they are also asked to complete "Travel Registration" in advance on the website of MOFA's Bureau of Consular Affairs ( www.boca.gov.tw ) or through the Bureau's official LINE account (ID: @boca.tw), and are also advised to download the "Travel Safety Guide" app (link: https://k7h2b.app.goo.gl/LrS1 ) to look up overseas safety information at any time. They should also check with the airline or consult the International Air Transport Association (IATA) website ( www.iatatravelcentre.com...

ES.summary_zh: 受全球暖化及氣候變遷影響,西班牙夏季高溫乾旱,森林火災風險升高,暑假期間Ávila、Madrid自治區、Guadalajara、Castellón、Almería及Huelva等地陸續發生大規模森林火災,造成大面積林地燒毀及居民疏散。外交部提醒國人暑期赴西班牙旅遊時,應儘量避開上述及周邊受災地區,並隨時留意並遵守當地政府相關指示,以維護自身安全。
ES.summary_en: Under the influence of global warming and climate change, Spain has hot, dry summers and a heightened risk of forest fires. During the summer holidays, large-scale forest fires have broken out one after another in places including Avila, the Community of Madrid, Guadalajara, Castellon, Almeria and Huelva, burning large areas of woodland and forcing residents to evacuate. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals travelling to Spain in the summer to avoid the above areas and the affected surrounding areas as far as possible, and to keep following and complying with the relevant instructions of local authorities in order to protect their own safety.

FI.summary_zh: 國人赴歐洲旅遊請務必購買海外急難救助及足額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間內自身的安全與權益;行前並與親友或雇主洽妥國際匯款方式,以備及時獲得財務濟助。旅遊期間務必小心自身護照及身分證件及錢財,倘護照或錢財遭竊,請立即向當地警察局報案。
FI.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling to Europe must purchase overseas emergency assistance and adequate medical insurance to protect their safety and rights during the trip. Before departure, they should also arrange with relatives, friends or employers a way of receiving international remittances so that they can obtain financial help promptly. During the trip, take care of your passport, identity documents and money; if your passport or money is stolen, report it to the local police immediately.

FJ.summary_zh: 斐濟已取消COVID-19疫情相關入境及檢疫規定。
FJ.summary_en: Fiji has lifted its COVID-19-related entry and quarantine requirements.

FM.summary_zh: 密克羅尼西亞聯邦政府已取消COVID-19入境檢疫相關措施。
FM.summary_en: The government of the Federated States of Micronesia has lifted its COVID-19 entry quarantine measures.

FR.summary_zh: 根據法國媒體報導,近期法國將持續發生大規模示威抗議活動,駐法國代表處提醒在法國境內的留學生、僑胞及前往旅遊的國人,密切注意抗議活動相關訊息,避免前往抗議地點及其周邊地區,加強維護自身安全。倘遭遇抗議活動,務請儘快設法離開現場,避免遭到波及。
FR.summary_en: According to French media reports, large-scale demonstrations and protests are expected to continue in France in the near future. The Taipei Representative Office in France reminds students, overseas Taiwanese and Taiwanese nationals travelling in France to pay close attention to information on protest activities, avoid protest sites and surrounding areas, and take extra care for their personal safety. If caught up in a protest, please leave the scene as soon as possible to avoid being affected.

GA.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
GA.summary_en: China's "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" takes effect on 1 July 2026. It states that "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine China's ethnic unity and progress or engage in ethnic separatism will be held legally liable in accordance with the law", an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction that threatens foreign nationals outside China. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying overseas, in order to protect their own rights and personal safety.

GB.summary_zh: 目前英國整體治安情勢穩定,但近來恐怖攻擊、族群衝突、示威活動及偷竊詐騙頻仍,仍可能影響旅外國人安全,請國人提高警覺,注意自身安全。
GB.summary_en: Public security in the United Kingdom is currently stable overall, but terrorist attacks, ethnic clashes, demonstrations, theft and fraud have been frequent recently and may still affect the safety of Taiwanese nationals abroad. Taiwanese nationals are asked to stay alert and look after their own safety.

GD.summary_zh: 格瑞那達治安大致良好,惟首都與旅遊熱區偶有扒竊、搶劫等事件,建議國人旅遊時應注意財物及自身安全,並避免出入複雜場所與夜間獨行,倘有緊急狀況可聯繫格國警方,電話為911。
GD.summary_en: Public security in Grenada is generally good, but pickpocketing, robbery and similar incidents occur occasionally in the capital and in popular tourist areas. Taiwanese nationals are advised to look after their belongings and personal safety while travelling, to avoid frequenting complicated venues and walking alone at night, and, in an emergency, to contact the Grenadian police on 911.

GE.summary_zh: 喬治亞政府已取消包括我國人在內之外國公民COVID-19疫情入境限制措施,惟受俄烏戰爭影響,建議國人非必要避免前往。
GE.summary_en: The Georgian government has lifted COVID-19 entry restrictions for foreign nationals, including Taiwanese nationals. However, because of the Russia-Ukraine war, MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid travelling there unless necessary.

GF.summary_zh: 法屬圭亞那存在蚊媒傳染病風險,包括茲卡病毒、登革熱、屈公病及黃熱病等,其中茲卡病毒可能對孕婦胎兒造成影響,建議孕婦審慎評估是否前往。旅客應採取防蚊措施,避免蚊蟲叮咬,並於出發前完成相關疫苗接種。相關訊息可參考衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁( https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
GF.summary_en: French Guiana carries a risk of mosquito-borne diseases, including Zika virus, dengue fever, chikungunya and yellow fever. Zika virus may affect the fetus of a pregnant woman, so pregnant women are advised to carefully assess whether to travel there. Travellers should take mosquito-protection measures to avoid mosquito bites and complete the relevant vaccinations before departure. For related information, please refer to the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (https://www.cdc.gov.tw).

GH.summary_zh: 迦納治安仍處不穩狀態,境內存在暴力犯罪及綁架等風險,首都Accra市之街頭隨機扒竊、行搶風險高,請審慎評估行程安全。
GH.summary_en: Security in Ghana remains unstable, with risks of violent crime and kidnapping. In Accra, the capital, there is a high risk of random street pickpocketing and robbery. Please carefully assess the safety of your itinerary.

GM.summary_zh: 甘比亞政經情勢仍處不穩狀態,觀光客有遭遇盜取、搶掠財務與護照等風險,請審慎評估行程安全。
GM.summary_en: The political and economic situation in The Gambia remains unstable, and tourists run the risk of having money, belongings and passports stolen or snatched. Please carefully assess the safety of your itinerary.

GN.summary_zh: 幾內亞部份地區存在暴力犯罪風險,請審慎評估行程安全,並遠離群眾聚集區域,注意自身安全。
GN.summary_en: Some parts of Guinea carry a risk of violent crime. Please carefully assess the safety of your itinerary, stay away from crowded gathering areas and pay attention to your personal safety.

GP.summary_zh: 法屬瓜地洛普觀光旺季為每年11月至次年4月,建議國人赴瓜地洛普旅遊時注意財物及自身安全。加勒比海颶風季為每年6月至11月,高峰期多集中於每年8月至10月,巨大風浪及不穩定氣流可能影響航班、船班及觀光活動,建議國人赴瓜地洛普旅遊前應注意交通資訊及天氣預報,並預作防災準備。
GP.summary_en: The peak tourist season in Guadeloupe, a French overseas territory, runs from November to April of the following year. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Guadeloupe are advised to take care of their belongings and personal safety. The Caribbean hurricane season runs from June to November, with the peak mostly between August and October. Huge waves and unstable air currents may affect flights, ferry services and tourist activities. Taiwanese nationals are advised to check transport information and weather forecasts before travelling to Guadeloupe and to make disaster-preparedness arrangements in advance.

GQ.summary_zh: 赤道幾內亞(以下簡稱「赤國」)整體治安不佳,首都馬拉波(Malabo)及最大城市巴塔(Bata)犯罪頻仍,夜間尤應提高警覺,建議國人避免夜間外出,並勿搭乘非官方計程車。另赤國海域曾發生海盜攻擊事件,不建議前往安諾本島(Annobón);當地警察與軍方臨檢頻繁,旅外國人應隨身攜帶護照以備查驗。
GQ.summary_en: Overall security in Equatorial Guinea (hereinafter "Equatorial Guinea") is poor. Crime is frequent in the capital Malabo and the largest city, Bata, and extra vigilance is needed at night. Taiwanese nationals are advised to avoid going out at night and not to take unofficial taxis. In addition, pirate attacks have occurred in Equatorial Guinea's waters, and travel to Annobón Island is not recommended. Police and military checkpoints are frequent, so foreign nationals should carry their passports with them for inspection.

GR.summary_zh: 希臘愛琴海觀光島嶼聖托里尼(Santorini)近日地震不斷,規模雖然不大,且研判非火山活動,但是希臘政府已經宣布當地進入緊急狀態,且預計執行至本(2025)年3月1日止。
GR.summary_en: Earthquakes have recently been occurring continuously on the Greek Aegean tourist island of Santorini. Although their magnitudes are not large and they are assessed not to be volcanic activity, the Greek government has declared a state of emergency on the island, expected to remain in force until 1 March of this year (2025).

GT.summary_zh: 瓜地馬拉運輸業者因燃油價格及道路安全法規等議題,於瓜國CA-1 Occidente、CA-2 Occidente、RN-01公路段,以及Petén省部分主要道路發起示威遊行及封路行動。提醒旅瓜國人避免前往受示威及封路影響之地區,出發前留意最新道路交通資訊,並視路況妥適調整行程及預留充裕交通時間。
GT.summary_en: Over issues such as fuel prices and road-safety regulations, Guatemalan transport operators have launched demonstrations and road blockades on the CA-1 Occidente, CA-2 Occidente and RN-01 highway sections, as well as on some major roads in the Petén department. Taiwanese nationals in Guatemala are reminded to avoid areas affected by demonstrations and road blockades, check the latest road and traffic information before setting out, and adjust their itineraries to road conditions, allowing ample travel time.

GW.summary_zh: 請國人在規劃幾內亞比索行程時,仍事先洽詢航空公司或參考國際航空運輸協會網頁資訊( https:// www.iatatravelcentre.com/world.php ),以瞭解轉機及入境有否最新的規定(也包含天候異常現象是否影響航班運作等情況),旅行期間請隨時注意個人安全與衛生健康。
GW.summary_en: When planning a trip to Guinea-Bissau, Taiwanese nationals are still advised to check in advance with airlines or refer to the International Air Transport Association website (https://www.iatatravelcentre.com/world.php) for the latest transit and entry requirements (including whether abnormal weather is affecting flight operations). During your trip, please pay attention to your personal safety and health at all times.

GY.summary_zh: 蓋亞那首都與旅遊熱區常見暴力犯罪,提醒國人避免夜間外出及進出複雜場所,另建議國人旅遊時應注意財物及自身安全,防範竊盜及汽車破窗行竊等犯罪活動,倘有緊急狀況可聯繫蓋國警方,電話為911。
GY.summary_en: Violent crime is common in Guyana's capital and popular tourist areas. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to avoid going out at night and entering disorderly venues, to take care of their belongings and personal safety when travelling, and to guard against crimes such as theft and car break-ins. In an emergency, contact the Guyanese police at 911.

HK.summary_zh: 陸委會自 2024 年 6 月 27 日起將香港旅遊警示調升為「橙色」燈號；2026 年 2 月 2 日表示考量當地情勢、法令及執法趨勢，仍維持橙色，建議國人避免非必要旅行。
HK.summary_en: Orange since 27 June 2024; on 2 February 2026 the Mainland Affairs Council said Hong Kong remains Orange given local laws and enforcement trends: avoid non-essential travel.

HN.summary_zh: 宏都拉斯政府政府已取消COVID-19入境檢疫相關措施,一般旅客入境宏國須填寫線上入境預約報到表( https://prechequeo.inm.gob.hn ),宏國政府將續審核入境資格。
HN.summary_en: The Honduran government has lifted its COVID-19 entry quarantine measures. General travellers entering Honduras must fill in the online entry pre-registration form (https://prechequeo.inm.gob.hn), and the Honduran government will continue to review entry eligibility.

HR.summary_zh: 國人來歐旅遊,常因護照與錢包放在一起保管遭竊,除了財物損失之外也造成後續旅遊行程延誤。另國人出國旅遊常有各種意想不到的情況發生,遇到生病或受傷時可能需要住院治療,由於遊客在克羅埃西亞自費醫療金額高昂,加護病房每日單價動輒高達數千歐元。
HR.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling in Europe often have their passports stolen because they are kept together with their wallets, causing not only financial loss but also delays to the rest of their trip. In addition, all kinds of unexpected situations often arise when Taiwanese nationals travel abroad, and illness or injury may require hospitalisation. Self-paid medical costs for tourists in Croatia are very high, with intensive care unit charges often reaching several thousand euros per day.

HT.summary_zh: 海地受到幫派暴力、政經局勢動盪及基礎設施損毀影響,全國治安極不穩定,不時發生槍擊、搶劫、綁架及甚至屠殺事件;首都太子港近90%區域為黑幫所控制,並盤據道路要衝任意勒索,國家警察(HNP)為維護治安時與黑幫駁火,政府運作及民眾生活均深受影響。
HT.summary_en: Haiti is affected by gang violence, political and economic turmoil and damaged infrastructure, and security across the country is extremely unstable, with shootings, robberies, kidnappings and even massacres occurring from time to time. Nearly 90% of the capital, Port-au-Prince, is controlled by gangs, who occupy key road junctions and extort money at will. The Haitian National Police (HNP) exchange fire with the gangs while maintaining order, and both government operations and people's daily lives are seriously affected.

HU.summary_zh: 外交部提醒國人赴歐洲旅遊前務必購買海外急難救助及足額 醫療保險,保障旅遊期間內自身的安全與權益;行前並與親友或雇主洽妥國際匯款方式,以備即時獲得濟助。旅遊期間務必小心自身護照及身分證件及錢財,倘護照或錢財遭竊,請立即向當地警察局報案。
HU.summary_en: MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals travelling to Europe to be sure to purchase overseas emergency assistance coverage and adequate medical insurance before departure to protect their safety and rights during the trip, and to arrange with relatives, friends or employers in advance how to receive international remittances so as to get timely help. During the trip, take great care of your passport, identity documents and money. If your passport or money is stolen, report it to the local police station immediately.

ID.summary_zh: 印尼峇里島為我國人熱門海外旅遊地點,近來常發生國人赴峇里島觀光溺水身亡的不幸事件,提醒國人從事水上或水下活動,除須確認該水域具有救生人員並落實各項必要安全措施外,亦須考量本身是否有不適合劇烈溫差的慢性疾病等狀況,否則不宜貿然下水活動。另外,一旦在水上或水下進行活動時,發現個人身體或週遭情形產生變化,必須立即停止活動並離開水域。

areas.area_zh: 中巴布亞省及高地巴布亞省
areas.area_en: Central Papua and Highland Papua provinces
areas.summary_zh: 日前印尼中巴布亞省(Central Papua)及高地巴布亞省(Highland Papua)發生境內分離主義武裝團體襲擊外籍人士情事,且襲擊對象擴及國有企業人員及非法採礦之外省民眾,印尼政府軍警與相關武裝團體間之游擊衝突恐將持續發生,外交部建議國人避免前往該地區。
areas.summary_en: Separatist armed groups recently attacked foreign nationals in Central Papua and Highland Papua provinces of Indonesia, and the targets of attacks have extended to personnel of state-owned enterprises and to people from other provinces engaged in illegal mining. Guerrilla clashes between Indonesian government military and police forces and the armed groups are likely to continue. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid travelling to these areas.

ID.summary_en: Bali, Indonesia, is a popular overseas destination for Taiwanese nationals, and there have recently been unfortunate incidents of Taiwanese tourists drowning in Bali. Taiwanese nationals engaging in water or underwater activities are reminded to confirm that the area has lifeguards and that all necessary safety measures are in place, and also to consider whether they have chronic illnesses or other conditions that make them unsuited to sharp temperature changes; otherwise they should not enter the water rashly. In addition, if during water or underwater activities you notice a change in your physical condition or in the surroundings, you must stop the activity immediately and leave the water.

IE.summary_zh: 愛爾蘭治安尚屬良好,惟都柏林市區熱門景點常有扒手出沒,近年搶劫、性暴力等犯罪亦有上升趨勢;另近期發生不法人士假冒當地或他國檢調人員,以民眾涉及不法、需受調查為由,向民眾騙取個資或財物的詐騙案件。提醒國人旅愛期間務必留意個人財物與人身安全,並對不明來電或訊息提高警覺。
IE.summary_en: Security in Ireland is generally good, but pickpockets frequently operate at popular attractions in central Dublin, and crimes such as robbery and sexual violence have been rising in recent years. In addition, there have recently been fraud cases in which criminals impersonate local or foreign investigators or prosecutors and, claiming that the victim is implicated in illegal activity and must be investigated, defraud them of personal data or property. Taiwanese nationals in Ireland are reminded to take care of their belongings and personal safety and to be vigilant about unknown calls and messages.

IL.summary_zh: 以色列整體安全情勢趨向穩定,以色列國土防衛部對民眾之安全指引恢復全境正常狀態,且各類集會不再受限。

areas.area_zh: 以色列-黎巴嫩邊界地區
areas.summary_zh: 以色列與黎巴嫩真主黨時有交戰,兩國邊境局勢仍不穩定。外交部建議國人不宜前往以黎邊境地區商旅,應儘速離境。
areas.summary_en: Israel and Lebanon's Hezbollah engage in fighting from time to time, and the situation along the border between the two countries remains unstable. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals not to travel to the Israel-Lebanon border area for business or tourism, and to leave as soon as possible.

IL.summary_en: The overall security situation in Israel is becoming stable. The Israeli Home Front Command's safety guidelines for the public have returned to normal status nationwide, and gatherings of all kinds are no longer restricted.

IN.summary_zh: 印度幅員廣闊各地發展程度不一,相對較為落後地方之醫療衛生條件欠缺,國人前來印度旅行應特別留意。部分地區由於族群衝突,時有恐怖攻擊案件發生。考量印度國情、宗教與社會情勢,應迴避爭端地區,並請謹慎個人言行免遭捲入。

areas.area_zh: 印度-鄰近巴基斯坦地區
areas.summary_zh: 喀什米爾地區因恐怖攻擊事件,引發印度與巴基斯坦邊境地區武裝衝突。目前雙邊緊張情勢略有和緩,建議國人如無必要,應避免前往印度與巴基斯坦邊境地區,並請隨時留意局勢演變。
areas.summary_en: Terrorist attacks in the Kashmir region have triggered armed conflict in the border areas between India and Pakistan. The tension between the two sides has eased slightly for now. Taiwanese nationals are advised to avoid the India-Pakistan border areas unless necessary and to keep following developments.

areas.area_zh: 西孟加拉州(West Bengal)及喀拉拉州(Kerala)
areas.summary_zh: 印度南部喀拉拉州(Kerala)前於2023年9月爆發立百病毒(Nipah Virus)疫情後,於2024年1月暫獲控制,無新病例傳出。惟2024年7月21日喀州及泰米爾那都州(Tamil Nadu)邊界之Coimbatore區發生1名14歲男童因感染立百病毒死亡案例,泰州已於邊界提高警戒,對入境人士進行檢測;另2026年1月西孟加拉州亦傳出疫情,截至1月25日已累計5例確診,其中2例病況嚴重。WHO評估,孟加拉、印度及鄰近地區仍存在…
areas.summary_en: After an outbreak of Nipah virus in Kerala, in southern India, in September 2023, the situation was temporarily brought under control in January 2024 with no new cases reported. However, on 21 July 2024 a 14-year-old boy died of Nipah virus infection in Coimbatore district on the border between Kerala and Tamil Nadu, and Tamil Nadu has raised alert levels at the border and is testing people entering. In addition, an outbreak was also reported in West Bengal in January 2026, with 5 confirmed cases accumulated as of 25 January, 2 of them in serious condition. WHO assesses that Bangladesh, India and neighbouring areas still face...

IN.summary_en: India is vast and its regions are at different stages of development. Medical and health conditions are lacking in relatively less developed areas, and Taiwanese nationals travelling in India should take particular care. Terrorist attacks occur from time to time in some areas because of ethnic conflict. Given India's national conditions and its religious and social situation, travellers should avoid disputed areas and be careful in their words and conduct so as not to get drawn in.

IQ.summary_zh: 伊拉克庫德族地區有其自治政府,倘獲該自治政府所核發之簽證,僅可前往庫德自治政府轄區,並不具前往伊拉克中央政府管轄地區之效力,惟倘由伊國駐外大使館核發之伊拉克簽證,一般能通行伊拉克全境(包括庫德自治區)。
IQ.summary_en: Iraq's Kurdish region has its own autonomous government. A visa issued by that autonomous government is valid only for travel within the territory under the Kurdistan Regional Government and does not permit travel to areas under the Iraqi central government's jurisdiction, whereas an Iraqi visa issued by an Iraqi embassy abroad generally allows travel throughout Iraq (including the Kurdistan Autonomous Region).

IR.summary_zh: 近期因伊朗核談判發展,中東緊張局勢再度升溫,多國並已發布提醒本國公民儘速撤離伊朗訊息。為保障旅外國人安全,外交部籲請在伊朗國人儘速離境,倘因故仍需前往,務請於出國前至外交部領事事務局「旅外國人動態登錄」網頁(網址:https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-abre-main-1.html)或透過領務局LINE帳號(ID: @boca.tw) 完成出國登錄。另亦建議下載「旅外安全指南」APP(連結:https://k7h2b…

areas.area_zh: 伊朗東部與阿富汗、巴基斯坦交界之希斯坦-俾路支省(Sistan-Baluchistan)、呼羅珊省(Khorasan),以及伊朗西部與伊拉克交界之古札斯坦省(Khuzestan)、可曼沙省(Kermanshah)及伊蘭省(Ilam)等省份
areas.area_en: Sistan-Baluchistan and Khorasan provinces in eastern Iran, bordering Afghanistan and Pakistan, and Khuzestan, Kermanshah and Ilam provinces in western Iran, bordering Iraq
areas.summary_zh: 2023年12月巴基斯坦俾路支省(Baluchistan)境內之遜尼派武裝組織「正義軍」(Jaish al-Adl)對伊朗希斯坦-俾路支省(Sistan-Baluchistan)拉斯克市(Rask)恐攻,造成10多名伊朗人死亡;2024年4月4日位於希斯坦-俾路支省(Sistan-Baluchistan)之伊朗東南部軍事總部再遭「正義軍」襲擊,雙方死亡人數逾20人。
areas.summary_en: In December 2023, the Sunni armed group "Jaish al-Adl", based in Baluchistan province in Pakistan, carried out a terrorist attack in Rask, Sistan-Baluchistan province, Iran, killing more than 10 Iranians. On 4 April 2024, the south-eastern Iranian military headquarters in Sistan-Baluchistan province was attacked again by Jaish al-Adl, and the combined death toll on both sides exceeded 20.

IR.summary_en: Recently, because of developments in the Iran nuclear negotiations, tensions in the Middle East have risen again, and a number of countries have issued messages urging their citizens to leave Iran as soon as possible. To protect the safety of Taiwanese nationals abroad, MOFA urges Taiwanese nationals in Iran to leave as soon as possible. If travel there is still unavoidable, please complete overseas travel registration before departure on the "Registration of Taiwanese Nationals Traveling Abroad" webpage of MOFA's Bureau of Consular Affairs (URL: https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-abre-main-1.html) or via the Bureau of Consular Affairs LINE account (ID: @boca.tw). It is also recommended to download the "Travel Safety Guide" app (link: https://k7h2b...

IS.summary_zh: 2023年12月18日晚間一座位於冰島西南端雷克雅內斯半島(Reykjanes peninsula)漁村格林達維克(Grindavik)以北地區的火山開始噴發,間歇噴出的熔岩持續湧出,導致地面出現長約3.5公里裂縫,威脅鄰近村鎮並導致冰島首都雷克雅維克(Reykjavik)近郊的凱夫拉維克國際機場(Keflavik International Airport)眾多航班起降延誤。嗣後冰島旅遊官網公告雷克雅內斯半島之Sýlingarfel…
IS.summary_en: On the evening of 18 December 2023, a volcano north of the fishing village of Grindavik, on the Reykjanes peninsula in south-western Iceland, began to erupt. Lava has continued to spew out intermittently, opening a fissure in the ground about 3.5 kilometres long, threatening nearby towns and villages and causing delays to numerous takeoffs and landings at Keflavik International Airport, near the capital Reykjavik. Subsequently, Iceland's official tourism website announced that Sýlingarfel...

IT.summary_zh: 夏季暑休期間,義大利各地觀光景點人潮眾多,來義外國旅客是當地扒手及竊盜集團覬覦目標。提醒國人隨時提高警覺,注意保管隨身包包或皮夾,尤其前往人潮擁擠地區更須注意。護照正本應妥善收存,出入攜少額現金及信用卡即可,以降低風險。

areas.area_zh: 義大利北部米蘭(Milano)、杜林(Torino)及波隆納(Bologna)等城市
areas.area_en: Northern Italian cities including Milan (Milano), Turin (Torino) and Bologna
areas.summary_zh: 根據義大利媒體報導,義大利北部米蘭(Milano)、杜林(Torino)及波隆納(Bologna)等城市近期發生多起抗議示威活動,駐義大利代表處及駐米蘭辦事處提醒在義大利境內的留學生、僑胞及前往旅遊的國人,隨時留意當地警方公告及交通資訊,避免前往抗議地點及其周邊地區,並注意人身及財物安全。倘遭遇抗議活動,務請儘快設法離開現場,避免遭到波及。
areas.summary_en: According to Italian media, a number of protests and demonstrations have recently taken place in cities in northern Italy including Milan (Milano), Turin (Torino) and Bologna. The Taipei Representative Office in Italy and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Milan remind students, overseas Taiwanese and Taiwanese nationals travelling in Italy to follow local police announcements and traffic information at all times, avoid protest sites and surrounding areas, and take care of their personal safety and belongings. If caught near a protest, leave the scene as soon as possible to avoid being affected.

IT.summary_en: During the summer holiday period, tourist attractions across Italy are crowded, and foreign visitors to Italy are targets for local pickpockets and theft gangs. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to stay vigilant at all times and to look after their bags and wallets, especially when visiting crowded areas. Keep your original passport in a safe place and carry only a small amount of cash and a credit card when going out to reduce risk.

JM.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區6月至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),請國人赴牙買加商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災請依照當地政府指示避難,並聯繫駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館提供必要協助。
JM.summary_en: June to November is the hurricane season in the Caribbean. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Jamaica for business or tourism must check weather forecasts at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, please follow local government instructions to take shelter and contact the Taiwan Embassy in Saint Christopher and Nevis for necessary assistance.

JO.summary_zh: 自本(2026)年7月8日起,美伊再度爆發衝突,並有多起伊朗針對約旦境內軍事設施之攻擊。考量中東區域情勢仍未明朗穩定且仍時有升高之可能,外交部呼籲短期內計劃前往約旦之國人,重新評估前往之必要性,倘仍有前往需求亦請預先向航空公司確認班機狀態,並留意自身安全。

areas.area_zh: 與敘利亞及伊拉克邊境
areas.summary_zh: 約旦Mansheyat Al-Ghayyath、Ruwayshid及約旦與敘利亞及伊拉克邊境區域仍有安全風險,請避免前往。
areas.summary_en: Security risks remain in Mansheyat Al-Ghayyath, Ruwayshid and the border areas between Jordan and Syria and Iraq. Please avoid travelling there.

JO.summary_en: Since 8 July of this year (2026), conflict between the United States and Iran has broken out again, and Iran has carried out several attacks on military facilities within Jordan. Given that the regional situation in the Middle East remains unclear and unstable and may escalate at times, MOFA urges Taiwanese nationals planning to travel to Jordan in the short term to reassess whether the trip is necessary. If travel is still needed, please confirm flight status with the airline in advance and pay attention to your own safety.

JP.summary_zh: 自2023年4月29日零時起,所有入境旅客均無須提交72小時內PCR陰性證明或3劑疫苗接種證明。
JP.summary_en: From 00:00 on 29 April 2023, all arriving travellers are no longer required to submit a negative PCR test result taken within 72 hours or proof of 3 doses of vaccination.

KE.summary_zh: 肯亞於10月5日發現有史以來首宗自剛果(金夏沙)境外移入之伊波拉感染死亡病例,且確診病例有持續增加之趨勢,旅居肯亞之台商及僑民請遵守防疫措施,盡量避免與人肢體接觸及參加葬禮,以維護健康安全。
KE.summary_en: Kenya recorded on October 5 its first-ever Ebola death case imported from abroad from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa), and confirmed cases continue to show an upward trend. Taiwanese businesspeople and nationals residing in Kenya are advised to observe epidemic prevention measures, avoid physical contact with others as much as possible, and avoid attending funerals, in order to protect their health and safety.

KG.summary_zh: 吉爾吉斯與中國簽有司法互助條約及引渡協定,提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。

areas.area_zh: 吉爾吉斯與塔吉克及烏茲別克接壤邊界地區
areas.area_en: Kyrgyz Republic-Borders with Tajikistan and Uzbekistan
areas.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日施行《民族團結進步促進法》,針對境外組織及個人追究破壞民族團結進步及製造民族分裂的法律責任。吉國與中國簽有司法互助條約及引渡協定,提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
areas.summary_en: China implemented the "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" on 1 July 2026, which pursues legal liability against overseas organisations and individuals who undermine ethnic unity and progress or foment ethnic separatism. Kyrgyzstan has signed a judicial assistance treaty and an extradition agreement with China. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying abroad, in order to protect their rights and personal safety.

KG.summary_en: Kyrgyzstan has signed a judicial assistance treaty and an extradition agreement with China. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying abroad, in order to protect their rights and personal safety.

KH.summary_zh: 柬埔寨與泰國於2025年7月在兩國邊境發生軍事衝突後,目前仍偶有零星衝突,外交部提醒國人避免前往柬泰邊境,並隨時注意柬埔寨當局發布之最新消息,留意周遭環境、人身及財務安全。

areas.area_zh: 柏威夏省、奧多棉芷省、班達棉芷省、馬德望省、菩薩省、國公省
areas.area_en: Preah Vihear, Oddar Meanchey, Banteay Meanchey, Battambang, Pursat and Koh Kong provinces
areas.summary_zh: 柬埔寨與泰國兩國於2025年12月7日起連日在邊境發生軍事衝突,動用武器包含戰機、重砲、裝甲車、無人機、地雷等,柬國鄰接泰國省份包含柏威夏省、奧多棉芷省、班達棉芷省、馬德望省、菩薩省、國公省等陸續遭受戰火波及,迄今已造成柬國至少11名平民死亡,約74人受傷,泰國則有9名士兵死亡,逾120人受傷,另兩國各有逾20萬人遷移避難。
areas.summary_en: Military clashes have occurred along the border between Cambodia and Thailand on consecutive days since 7 December 2025, with weapons used including fighter jets, heavy artillery, armoured vehicles, drones and landmines. Cambodian provinces adjoining Thailand, including Preah Vihear, Oddar Meanchey, Banteay Meanchey, Battambang, Pursat and Koh Kong, have been affected by the fighting one after another. So far at least 11 Cambodian civilians have died and about 74 have been injured, while 9 Thai soldiers have died and more than 120 have been injured; in addition, more than 200,000 people on each side have been displaced.

KH.summary_en: Since the military clashes between Cambodia and Thailand along their border in July 2025, sporadic clashes still occur. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals to avoid the Cambodia-Thailand border, to keep following the latest announcements from the Cambodian authorities, and to pay attention to their surroundings and to their personal and financial safety.

KI.summary_zh: 吉國自2022年8月起恢復國際航班,前往吉國之國人須有疫苗接種證明,入境前無需接受COVID-19病毒檢測,入境後亦無需隔離檢疫,僅須於3日內接受快篩。吉國醫療落後,就醫不易,且我國在吉國並無館處,提醒國人前往仍宜小心謹防染疫。
KI.summary_en: Kiribati resumed international flights in August 2022. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Kiribati must have proof of vaccination; no COVID-19 test is required before entry and no quarantine after entry, only a rapid test within 3 days. Medical care in Kiribati is poor and hard to access, and Taiwan has no mission there, so Taiwanese nationals are reminded to remain careful to guard against infection when travelling there.

KM.summary_zh: 葛摩公共衛生狀況不佳,外交部提醒確有必要前往葛國的國人多加留意健康,並注意將自來水先煮沸後再飲用,確保飲用水衛生,並勤加洗手。
KM.summary_en: Public health conditions in Comoros are poor. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals who genuinely need to travel to Comoros to take extra care of their health, boil tap water before drinking it to ensure safe drinking water, and wash their hands frequently.

KN.name_zh: 聖克里斯多福及尼維斯
KN.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區6月至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),大雨恐造成土石流,切斷周遭社區與外界交通聯繫,請國人赴克商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災,請依照當地政府指示避難,並聯繫我駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館。
KN.summary_en: June to November is the hurricane season in the Caribbean, and heavy rain may cause landslides that cut off surrounding communities from the outside world. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Saint Christopher and Nevis for business or tourism must check weather forecasts at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, please follow local government instructions to take shelter and contact the Taiwan Embassy in Saint Christopher and Nevis.

KP.summary_zh: 2022年5月12日,北韓首都平壤首次發現COVID-19 Omicron BA.2變種病毒感染病例。北韓雖已宣布「戰勝COVID-19」,並取消口罩政策等相關防疫規定,惟由於北韓對外資訊不透明,亦從未證實有多少確診案例,真實情形外界難以得知,包括世界衛生組織專家均懷疑北韓疫情已受到控制的說法。
KP.summary_en: On 12 May 2022, the first COVID-19 Omicron BA.2 variant infections were detected in Pyongyang, the capital of North Korea. Although North Korea has declared "victory over COVID-19" and lifted the mask policy and other related epidemic-prevention rules, North Korea is not transparent with the outside world and has never confirmed how many cases there are, so the real situation is hard for outsiders to know, and even World Health Organization experts doubt the claim that the epidemic there has been brought under control.

KR.summary_zh: 目前韓國落實電子入境卡( https://www.e-arrivalcard.go.kr/ )及紙本入境卡並行,國人可以選擇填寫紙本入境卡入境。
KR.summary_en: South Korea currently implements both an electronic arrival card (https://www.e-arrivalcard.go.kr/) and a paper arrival card in parallel, and Taiwanese nationals may choose to fill in the paper arrival card to enter.

KW.summary_zh: 2026年2月伊朗對科威特發動空襲,中東情勢升高,迄今仍有零星攻擊事件發生,境內逮捕數名策劃恐怖攻擊人士,區域情勢仍不穩定。外交部呼籲國人提高警覺,密切注意區域情勢發展,並請留意科威特政府資訊。
KW.summary_en: In February 2026, Iran launched airstrikes on Kuwait and tensions in the Middle East escalated. Sporadic attacks still occur, several people plotting terrorist attacks have been arrested within the country, and the regional situation remains unstable. MOFA urges Taiwanese nationals to stay alert, closely follow developments in the regional situation, and pay attention to information from the Kuwaiti government.

KY.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區自6月起至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),開曼群島領土較小,大雨恐造成土石流,切斷周遭社區與外界交通聯繫,請國人赴當地商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災請依照當地政府指示避難並聯繫我駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館。
KY.summary_en: June to November is the hurricane season in the Caribbean. The Cayman Islands are a small territory, and heavy rain may cause landslides that cut off surrounding communities from the outside world. Taiwanese nationals travelling there for business or tourism must check weather forecasts at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, please follow local government instructions to take shelter and contact the Taiwan Embassy in Saint Christopher and Nevis.

KZ.summary_zh: 哈薩克政府已取消入境限制措施,外國公民入境哈國無須出示COVID-19核酸檢測陰性報告或疫苗接種證明,亦無須隔離。
KZ.summary_en: The Kazakh government has lifted its entry restrictions. Foreign nationals entering Kazakhstan are not required to present a negative COVID-19 nucleic acid test report or proof of vaccination, and are not required to quarantine.

LA.summary_zh: 自2022年初起外交部已接獲多起國人疑似遭到誘騙赴寮國求職之陳情案件,當事人多在網路及社群媒體遭「免經驗高薪、工作輕鬆、快速致富」等不實徵才廣告誘騙,以非法偷渡方式進入寮國金三角特區,抵達後除護照被扣留、人身自由遭限制外,亦被迫從事不法工作,倘不願配合,則動輒遭到不法分子恐嚇、威脅轉賣至其他不法集團或索取高額違約金等。寮國金三角特區因情況特殊,即使向寮國公安報案也多數無法成案。外交部呼籲有意前往寮國工作的國人,務必提高警覺,對於號稱高…
LA.summary_en: Since early 2022, MOFA has received multiple petitions from Taiwanese nationals who were apparently lured to Laos to find work. Most of them were deceived by false recruitment advertisements on the internet and social media promising "no experience needed, high pay, easy work, get rich quick", and entered the Golden Triangle Special Economic Zone in Laos by illegal smuggling. On arrival, besides having their passports confiscated and their personal freedom restricted, they were forced to do illegal work, and if they refused to cooperate they were often intimidated and threatened by criminals with being sold on to other criminal syndicates or with demands for high penalty payments. Because of the special situation in the Golden Triangle Special Economic Zone in Laos, most cases cannot be established even if reported to the Lao public security authorities. MOFA urges Taiwanese nationals who intend to work in Laos to stay highly alert and, regarding offers that claim high...

LB.summary_zh: 鑒於黎巴嫩政局及安全情勢複雜多變,復以黎國南部受加薩戰爭外溢影響,黎巴嫩安全情勢恐有複雜化之可能,籲請國人勿前往旅遊。
LB.summary_en: Given the complex and fast-changing political and security situation in Lebanon, and because the security situation there may become further complicated by spillover from the Gaza war in southern Lebanon, Taiwanese nationals are urged not to travel to Lebanon.

LC.summary_zh: 聖露西亞交通事故多,提醒國人自駕或搭乘交通工具時,須注意道路狀況、當地右駕習慣及行人安全。
LC.summary_en: Traffic accidents are frequent in Saint Lucia. Taiwanese nationals are reminded, when driving themselves or travelling by other means of transport, to pay attention to road conditions, the local practice of left-hand traffic with right-hand-drive vehicles, and pedestrian safety.

LI.summary_zh: 赴歐旅遊國人行前務必購妥海外急難救助及足額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間自身安全及權益。提醒國人旅遊期間將錢包及護照分開保管,避免同時遭竊;前往當地著名景點或人潮眾多場合,亦請隨時留意自身財物及安全。
LI.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling to Europe must purchase overseas emergency assistance and adequate medical insurance before departure to protect their safety and rights during the trip. They are reminded to keep their wallets and passports separately during the trip so that both are not stolen at the same time, and to keep a close watch on their belongings and personal safety at well-known attractions and in crowded places.

LK.summary_zh: 斯里蘭卡在新內閣上任後,政治局勢及社會秩序已呈現回穩,不過由於高額外債引發民生經濟問題及警察執法濫權,斯國各地仍偶見民眾群聚街頭抗議,要求政治及司法改革。大致而言,目前斯國境內可倫坡市區治安算是穩定,惟郊區偷盜等犯罪猖獗,國人在當地務須注意錢財甚至人身安全。
LK.summary_en: Since the new cabinet took office in Sri Lanka, the political situation and public order have stabilised. However, high external debt has caused livelihood and economic problems, and police have abused their powers of law enforcement, so people still occasionally gather to protest in streets across Sri Lanka, demanding political and judicial reform. By and large, security in central Colombo is currently stable, but crimes such as theft are rampant in suburban areas, and Taiwanese nationals there must take care of their money and even their personal safety.

LR.summary_zh: 賴比瑞亞境內政治情勢持續不穩,首都蒙羅維亞市時見民眾聚集陳抗,相關竊盜與搶掠等治安風險亦仍高,請審慎評估行程安全。
LR.summary_en: The political situation in Liberia remains unstable, with crowds frequently gathering to protest in the capital, Monrovia, and security risks such as theft and robbery remain high. Please carefully assess the safety of your itinerary.

LS.summary_zh: 賴索托首都馬賽盧(Maseru)、馬普索(Maputsoe)、萊里(Leribe)等大城常有大型政治集會遊行,加上賴國近期失業率高漲,犯罪率居高不下,入室搶劫、暴力劫車、竊盜案頻傳,在旅館及商業區針對旅客之竊盜及搶劫案件時有發生。建議國人避免單獨前往上述地區,並隨時提高警覺注意安全。
LS.summary_en: Large political rallies and marches often take place in Lesotho's major cities such as the capital Maseru, Maputsoe and Leribe. In addition, unemployment in Lesotho has recently risen sharply and the crime rate remains high, with frequent home-invasion robberies, violent carjackings and thefts; theft and robbery targeting tourists occur from time to time in hotels and commercial districts. Taiwanese nationals are advised to avoid visiting these areas alone and to stay vigilant about their safety at all times.

LT.summary_zh: 為利即時接收立國政府發布的緊急警報(如天災、事故、空襲等),建議國人下載立陶宛內政部發布之緊急應變APP「LT72」。
LT.summary_en: To receive emergency alerts issued by the Lithuanian government (such as natural disasters, accidents and air raids) in real time, Taiwanese nationals are advised to download the emergency response app "LT72" released by Lithuania's Ministry of the Interior.

LU.summary_zh: 盧森堡整體治安情況良好,惟基於歐洲整體安全情勢及國際恐怖主義威脅,盧森堡政府「反恐協調小組」(GCT)於2026年3月完成最新安全評估後,維持全國恐怖主義威脅等級為第2級(共4級),表示恐怖攻擊威脅仍有可能發生,但目前未有具體迫切威脅資訊。提醒國人旅盧期間仍應提高警覺,妥善保管個人財物,並特別留意火車站、公共運輸、觀光景點、大型活動場所及政府機關等人潮聚集區域之安全情形。
LU.summary_en: Overall security in Luxembourg is good. However, in view of the overall security situation in Europe and the threat of international terrorism, the Luxembourg government's counter-terrorism coordination group (GCT), after completing its latest security assessment in March 2026, maintained the national terrorism threat level at Level 2 (out of 4), indicating that a terrorist attack remains possible but that there is currently no information on a specific, imminent threat. Taiwanese nationals in Luxembourg are reminded to stay vigilant, keep their belongings safe, and pay particular attention to safety in crowded areas such as railway stations, public transport, tourist attractions, large event venues and government offices.

LV.summary_zh: 赴歐旅遊國人行前務必購妥海外急難救助及全額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間自身安全及權益。提醒國人旅遊期間將錢包及護照分開保管,避免同時遭竊;前往當地著名景點或人潮眾多場合,亦請隨時留意自身財物及安全。
LV.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling to Europe must purchase overseas emergency assistance and full medical insurance before departure to protect their safety and rights during the trip. They are reminded to keep their wallets and passports separately during the trip so that both are not stolen at the same time, and to keep a close watch on their belongings and personal safety at well-known attractions and in crowded places.

LY.summary_zh: 利比亞民族團結政府所屬武裝派系於2025年5月12日在利國首都的黎波里爆發流血衝突,造成多人傷亡,民族團結政府雖已宣布停火,惟零星衝突仍不時爆發。
LY.summary_en: Armed factions affiliated with Libya's Government of National Unity (GNU) clashed violently in the capital Tripoli on 12 May 2025, causing many casualties. Although the GNU has announced a ceasefire, sporadic clashes still break out from time to time.

MA.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人,且摩國支持「一中原則」,並與中國已簽署「刑事司法互助協定」及「引渡協定」,中國有權向該國申請法律協助或引渡逃犯。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
MA.summary_en: China has implemented the "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" since 1 July 2026, under which "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine ethnic unity and progress or foment ethnic separatism will be held legally liable according to law", an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction and threaten foreign nationals abroad. Morocco supports the "One China principle" and has signed a "mutual legal assistance in criminal matters agreement" and an "extradition agreement" with China, so China has the right to request legal assistance or the extradition of fugitives from Morocco. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying abroad, in order to protect their rights and personal safety.

MC.summary_zh: 國人赴摩納哥觀光旅遊時須注意提高警覺,以免財物遭扒竊,並請於赴歐洲旅遊前務必購買海外急難救助及足額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間內自身的安全與權益;行前並與親友或雇主洽妥國際匯款方式,以備即時獲得濟助。旅遊期間務必小心自身護照、身分證件及錢財,倘護照或錢財遭竊,請立即向當地警察局報案。
MC.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling in Monaco must stay vigilant to avoid having belongings pickpocketed. Before travelling in Europe, be sure to purchase overseas emergency assistance coverage and adequate medical insurance to protect your safety and rights during the trip, and arrange with relatives, friends or employers in advance how to receive international remittances so as to get timely help. During the trip, take great care of your passport, identity documents and money. If your passport or money is stolen, report it to the local police station immediately.

MD.summary_zh: 摩爾多瓦政府已取消包括我國人在內之外國公民COVID-19疫情入境限制措施,惟受俄烏戰爭影響,建議國人非必要避免前往。
MD.summary_en: The Moldovan government has lifted COVID-19 entry restrictions for foreign nationals, including Taiwanese nationals. However, because of the Russia-Ukraine war, MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid travelling there unless necessary.

ME.summary_zh: 蒙特內哥羅在2023年10月順利完成第二度政黨輪替後,除偶有零星陳抗事件之外,整體政局已趨穩定,建議隨時注意當地新聞資訊,以確保旅遊時自身安全,並請避免涉入任何政治活動。
ME.summary_en: After Montenegro successfully completed its second change of governing party in October 2023, apart from occasional sporadic protests, the overall political situation has become stable. Taiwanese nationals are advised to follow local news at all times to ensure their own safety while travelling, and to avoid involvement in any political activity.

MF.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區6月至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),聖馬丁領土較小,大雨恐造成土石流,切斷周遭社區與外界交通聯繫,請國人赴當地商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災請依照當地政府指示避難,並聯繫我駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館提供必要協助。
MF.summary_en: June to November is the hurricane season in the Caribbean. Saint Martin is a small territory, and heavy rain may cause landslides that cut off surrounding communities from the outside world. Taiwanese nationals travelling there for business or tourism must check weather forecasts at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, please follow local government instructions to take shelter and contact the Taiwan Embassy in Saint Christopher and Nevis for necessary assistance.

MG.summary_zh: 馬達加斯加全境出現示威抗議活動,可能在毫無預警下惡化為暴動,請國人暫時避免前往馬國商旅。
MG.summary_en: Demonstrations and protests are taking place across Madagascar and may turn into riots without warning. Taiwanese nationals are asked to temporarily avoid travelling to Madagascar for business or tourism.

MH.summary_zh: 馬國出現登革熱確診案例,請國人訪馬時使用防蚊液、於外出時著長袖衣褲,並提高警覺,若有持續發燒、頭痛、眼窩後疼痛、肌肉或關節痠痛、皮疹、噁心或嘔吐等症狀,請儘速就醫。
MH.summary_en: The Marshall Islands has confirmed dengue cases. Taiwanese nationals visiting are advised to use insect repellent, wear long sleeves and long trousers when outdoors, and stay alert. If symptoms such as persistent fever, headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle or joint aches, rash, nausea or vomiting occur, seek medical attention promptly.

MK.summary_zh: 我國人持中華民國(臺灣)護照(效期6個月以上)享有可在180天內免簽證入境觀光旅遊不超過90天待遇,外交部另提醒國人,持免簽證入境待遇係供短期觀光商旅之用,倘須工作應向北馬其頓政府主管機關申辦工作許可,並請留意切勿從事非法工作及違反當地法令。
