MK.summary_en: Holders of a Republic of China (Taiwan) passport valid for at least 6 months enjoy visa-free entry for tourism for up to 90 days within 180 days. MOFA also reminds Taiwanese nationals that visa-free entry is intended for short-term tourism and business trips; if they need to work, they must apply for a work permit from the competent North Macedonian authority, and they must take care not to engage in illegal work or violate local laws and regulations.

ML.summary_zh: 馬利全國各地自本(2026)年4月25日起遭聖戰組織「伊斯蘭及穆斯林援助團」(JNIM)及北部圖阿雷格(Touareg)叛軍聯盟「阿札瓦德解放陣線」(FLA)發動大規模聯合攻勢,意在驅逐俄軍勢力並推翻馬利軍政府政權,該國當前安全情勢仍極度不穩定,外交部提醒我國人勿前往馬利。
ML.summary_en: Since 25 April of this year (2026), a large-scale joint offensive has been launched across Mali by the jihadist group "Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin" (JNIM) and the northern Tuareg rebel alliance "Azawad Liberation Front" (FLA), aiming to drive out Russian forces and overthrow Mali's military government. The security situation in the country remains extremely unstable, and MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals not to travel to Mali.

MM.summary_zh: 緬甸撣邦(Shan State)南部及東部、德林達依省(Tanintharyi Region)之德林達依縣以南鄰泰國邊界地區、曼德勒省(Mandalay Region)北部以外地區、勃固省(Bago Region)仰光-曼德勒快速道路以東以外地區、伊洛瓦底省(Ayeyarwady Region)所轄Kyangin、Myanaung、Ingapu、Lemyethna、Yegyi、Thabaung及Pathein等7縣與若開邦接壤邊界地區…

areas.area_zh: 克欽邦(Kachin State)、欽邦(Chin State)、克耶邦(Kayah State)、克倫邦(Kayin State)、實皆省(Sagaing Region)、若開邦(Rakhine State)、撣邦北部(Shan State North)、德林達依省(Tanintharyi Region)(Myeik縣及德林達依縣以南各縣及島嶼除外)、馬圭省(Magway Region)、曼德勒省(Mandalay Region)北部、孟邦(Mon State)及勃固省(Bago Region)仰光-曼德勒快速道路以東地區
areas.area_en: Kachin State, Chin State, Kayah State, Kayin State, Sagaing Region, Rakhine State, northern Shan State, Tanintharyi Region (except Myeik township and the townships and islands south of Tanintharyi township), Magway Region, northern Mandalay Region, Mon State, and the area of Bago Region east of the Yangon-Mandalay Expressway
areas.summary_zh: 上述地區屬緬甸地方民族武裝組織(Ethnic Armed Organizations, EAOs)與政府軍武裝衝突交戰、人口及毒品走私與電信詐騙等犯罪聚集且非政府公權力管轄所及之高風險地區,請國人切勿前往滯留並應儘速離境,以確保人身安全。
areas.summary_en: The above areas are high-risk areas where armed conflict between Myanmar's local Ethnic Armed Organizations (EAOs) and government forces takes place, where crimes such as human and drug smuggling and telecom fraud are concentrated, and which are beyond the reach of government authority. Taiwanese nationals must not travel to or stay in them and should leave as soon as possible to ensure their personal safety.

areas.area_zh: 緬甸仰光省(Yangon Region)、奈比都(Nay Pyi Taw)以及其它列示第三級(避免前往)及第四級(儘速離境)以外地區
areas.area_en: Yangon Region, Nay Pyi Taw, and other areas not listed as Level 3 (avoid travel) or Level 4 (leave immediately)
areas.summary_zh: 上述地區雖非屬緬甸地方民族武裝組織(Ethnic Armed Organizations, EAOs)與政府軍武裝衝突交戰或跨國犯罪風險地區,惟仍請國人隨時注意人身安全。
areas.summary_en: Although the above areas are not areas of armed conflict between Myanmar's local Ethnic Armed Organizations (EAOs) and government forces or areas at risk of transnational crime, Taiwanese nationals should still pay attention to their personal safety at all times.

MM.summary_en: Southern and eastern Shan State, Myanmar; the area of Tanintharyi Region south of Tanintharyi township bordering Thailand; Mandalay Region except for the northern part; Bago Region except for the area east of the Yangon-Mandalay Expressway; and the areas of Ayeyarwady Region bordering Rakhine State in the 7 townships of Kyangin, Myanaung, Ingapu, Lemyethna, Yegyi, Thabaung and Pathein...

MN.summary_zh: 2026年10月8日於烏蘭巴托郊區傳出大型棕熊闖入居民區攻擊人事件,造成一死一重傷,蒙古國各省山區或平原牧區頻傳熊蹤,烏蘭巴托周邊山區及近郊觀光勝地博格達汗山區已發現24起熊蹤,蒙古政府明確建議民眾近期避免進入森林或山區,亦應避免於無人跡之原野單獨行動。旅客倘發現熊蹤,應保持冷靜並儘速離開當地。
MN.summary_en: On 8 October 2026, a large brown bear entered a residential area on the outskirts of Ulaanbaatar and attacked people, leaving one person dead and another seriously injured. Bear sightings are frequently reported in mountain areas and plains pastureland across Mongolia's provinces; 24 bear sightings have been recorded in the mountains around Ulaanbaatar and in Bogd Khan Mountain, a tourist attraction on the city's outskirts. The Mongolian government has expressly advised the public to avoid entering forests or mountain areas for the time being, and to avoid going alone into uninhabited open country. Travellers who discover signs of a bear should stay calm and leave the area as quickly as possible.

MO.summary_zh: 陸委會自 2024 年 6 月 27 日起將澳門旅遊警示調升為「橙色」燈號；2026 年 2 月 2 日表示仍維持橙色，建議國人避免非必要旅行。
MO.summary_en: Orange since 27 June 2024; on 2 February 2026 the Mainland Affairs Council said Macau remains Orange: avoid non-essential travel.

MP.name_en: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands(CNMI)

MQ.summary_zh: 法屬馬丁尼克觀光旺季為每年11月至次年4月,建議國人赴馬丁尼克旅遊時注意財物及自身安全。加勒比海颶風季為每年6月至11月,高峰期多集中於年8月至10月。2025年10月颶風Melissa造成多處嚴重損害,當地重建工作持續進行中,提醒國人注意交通及旅遊設施可能臨時出現變動或調整服務之情況。
MQ.summary_en: The peak tourist season in French Martinique runs from November to April of the following year; Taiwanese nationals travelling to Martinique are advised to take care of their belongings and personal safety. The Caribbean hurricane season runs from June to November, with the peak mostly from August to October. In October 2025, Hurricane Melissa caused serious damage in many places, and local reconstruction work is still under way; Taiwanese nationals are reminded that transport and tourism facilities may be temporarily changed or have services adjusted.

MR.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
MR.summary_en: China's "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" takes effect on 1 July 2026. It states that "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine China's ethnic unity and progress or engage in ethnic separatism will be held legally liable in accordance with the law", an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction that threatens foreign nationals outside China. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying overseas, in order to protect their own rights and personal safety.

MS.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區6月至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),英屬蒙哲臘領土較小,大雨恐造成土石流,切斷周遭社區與外界交通聯繫,請國人赴當地商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災請依照當地政府指示避難,並聯繫我駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館提供必要協助。
MS.summary_en: The hurricane season in the Caribbean runs from June to November. The British territory of Montserrat is small, and heavy rain may cause landslides that cut off surrounding communities from the outside world. Taiwanese nationals travelling there for business or tourism must keep checking weather forecasts at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, please follow the instructions of the local government to take shelter, and contact the Embassy of the Republic of China (Taiwan) in Saint Kitts and Nevis for the necessary assistance.

MT.summary_zh: 我國人持中華民國(臺灣)護照(效期6個月以上)享有180天內免簽證入境包括馬爾他之申根區觀光旅遊90天待遇,免簽證入境待遇係供短期觀光商旅之用,倘須工作應向馬爾他當局申辦工作許可,並請留意切勿從事非法工作及違反當地法令。
MT.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals holding a Republic of China (Taiwan) passport valid for at least 6 months enjoy visa-free entry for tourism, including to Malta, for up to 90 days within any 180-day period in the Schengen Area. Visa-free entry is intended for short-term tourism and business trips. Those who need to work must apply to the Maltese authorities for a work permit, and should take care not to engage in illegal work or violate local laws and regulations.

MU.summary_zh: 模里西斯法律明文禁止任何人下海與鯨魚共游,外交部提醒國人赴模國觀光時尊重當地法規,切勿以身試法。
MU.summary_en: Mauritian law expressly prohibits anyone from entering the sea to swim with whales. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals visiting Mauritius as tourists to respect local laws and regulations and not to break the law.

MW.summary_zh: 馬拉威治安情況不佳,犯罪率高,在首都里朗威(Lilongwe)和第二大城布蘭岱(Blantyre)的主要巴士站附近,時有針對遊客的竊盜案件發生,提醒國人行經上述地點時注意安全,並避免於夜間外出及獨行。
MW.summary_en: Public security in Malawi is poor and the crime rate is high. Thefts targeting tourists occur from time to time near the main bus stations in the capital, Lilongwe, and in the second-largest city, Blantyre. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to take care when passing these places, and to avoid going out at night or alone.

MX.summary_zh: 近期墨西哥麻疹疫情升溫,主要地區包括北部奇瓦瓦州(Estado de Chihuahua)、墨西哥州(Estado de México)及墨西哥市(Ciudad de México)等地。提醒國人前往墨西哥時注意相關健康風險,並於出發前評估接種麻疹、腮腺炎及德國麻疹(MMR)疫苗。旅途期間請注意個人衛生並做好防護措施,避免前往人潮眾多或通風不良場所。
MX.summary_en: Measles outbreaks in Mexico have recently intensified, mainly in areas including the northern state of Chihuahua (Estado de Chihuahua), the State of Mexico (Estado de Mexico) and Mexico City (Ciudad de Mexico). Taiwanese nationals travelling to Mexico are reminded to be aware of the related health risks and to consider, before departure, getting vaccinated against measles, mumps and rubella (MMR). During the trip, please pay attention to personal hygiene, take protective measures, and avoid crowded or poorly ventilated places.

MY.summary_zh: 為避免意外事件發生後衍生之高額醫療費用,建議國人赴馬旅遊前事先投保旅遊平安/意外/醫療等保險。

areas.area_zh: 沙巴東部沿海地區
areas.summary_zh: 鑒於馬來西亞沙巴州東部沿海地區,包括島嶼、潛水地點、度假村及相關旅遊設施等存在綁架風險,建議國人前往該地區旅行,宜高度警覺並特別注意旅遊安全,並檢討應否前往。
areas.summary_en: In view of the risk of kidnapping along the eastern coastal areas of Sabah state, Malaysia, including islands, diving sites, resorts and related tourist facilities, Taiwanese nationals travelling to this area are advised to stay highly alert, pay special attention to travel safety, and reconsider whether to go.

MY.summary_en: To avoid the high medical costs that may arise after an accident, Taiwanese nationals are advised to take out travel accident/medical and other insurance before travelling to Malaysia.

MZ.summary_zh: 莫三比克首都Maputo市近來偶有針對外國人士之綁架案件,籲請國人赴訪時,避免錢財露白,並提高警覺,注意安全,尤其於入夜後,儘量避免外出。

areas.area_zh: Cabo Delgado省
areas.summary_zh: 莫三比克東北部Cabo Delgado省及鄰坦尚尼亞邊境,因爭奪天然氣等礦產資源,時有伊斯蘭武裝叛亂份子不法活動,致社會動盪、治安惡化,2024年1月以來恐怖攻擊事件激增,國人應避免前往。
areas.summary_en: In Cabo Delgado Province in northeastern Mozambique and along the border with neighbouring Tanzania, Islamist armed insurgents carry out unlawful activities from time to time in competition over mineral resources such as natural gas, causing social unrest and a deterioration in public security. Terrorist attacks have surged since January 2024. Taiwanese nationals should avoid travelling there.

MZ.summary_en: Kidnapping cases targeting foreigners have occurred occasionally in recent times in Maputo, the capital of Mozambique. Taiwanese nationals visiting are urged not to display money or valuables, to stay alert and mindful of their safety, and in particular to avoid going out after dark as far as possible.

NA.summary_zh: 納國政局尚屬穩定,惟國人赴納旅遊時仍須注意扒竊、搶奪皮包、ATM金融卡誘騙取財、信用卡盜刷、砸破車輛車窗取財等情形。另近年來在首都Windhoek發生之暴力搶劫案有增加之趨勢。
NA.summary_en: Namibia's political situation is relatively stable, but Taiwanese nationals travelling to Namibia must still beware of pickpocketing, bag snatching, ATM card scams, credit card fraud, and theft from vehicles after smashing the windows. In addition, violent robberies in the capital, Windhoek, have shown an increasing trend in recent years.

NC.summary_zh: 新喀里多尼亞在2024年5月發生暴動,目前雖然局勢趨穩,但政局依然脆弱,當地觀光設施與日常生活已漸恢復,國人前往商旅仍應多加留意避開任何政治集會。
NC.summary_en: Riots broke out in New Caledonia in May 2024. Although the situation has now stabilised, the political situation remains fragile. Local tourist facilities and daily life have gradually resumed, but Taiwanese nationals travelling there for business or leisure should still take care to avoid any political gatherings.

NE.summary_zh: 尼日2026年以來安全情勢持續惡化,首都尼阿美國際機場及空軍基地先後於1月及6月遭聖戰組織攻擊,西部及南部地區亦頻傳武裝襲擊;復於8月29日發生部分軍人兵變,總統府、國際機場及國營廣電等重要設施周邊爆發交火。目前尼日軍政府已宣布控制局勢,首都大致恢復平靜,惟軍方內部動盪及恐怖攻擊威脅仍存,該國整體安全情勢高度不穩定,外交部提醒我國人勿前往尼日。
NE.summary_en: Niger's security situation has continued to deteriorate since the start of 2026. Niamey International Airport and the air force base in the capital were attacked by jihadist groups in January and June respectively, and armed attacks are also frequent in the west and south. Furthermore, on 29 August a mutiny by some soldiers broke out, with gunfire erupting around key facilities such as the presidential palace, the international airport and the state broadcaster. The Nigerien military government has now announced that it has the situation under control and the capital has largely returned to calm, but turmoil within the military and the threat of terrorist attacks remain, and the country's overall security situation is highly unstable. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals not to travel to Niger.

NG.summary_zh: 奈及利亞總統提努布(Bola Tinubu)日前發布全國治安緊急狀態(Security Emergency),大規模清剿境內近期連續發生之劫掠綁匪與恐攻組織行動等重大案件。
NG.summary_en: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu has recently declared a nationwide Security Emergency, with large-scale operations to root out the recent series of major incidents involving raiding and kidnapping gangs and terrorist groups within the country.

NI.summary_zh: 尼國政府要求入境旅客出示COVID-19疫苗施打證明,倘未能提出疫苗證明,則須向搭乘航班之航空公司遞交入境尼國前72小時之核酸檢測(PCR)陰性報告,另建議於購買機票後向航空公司或旅行社洽詢預先填報入境申請表事宜。倘經陸路入境者,須另先至移民局網站線上填寫申請表( https://solicitudes.migob.gob.ni )。
NI.summary_en: The Nicaraguan government requires entering travellers to present proof of COVID-19 vaccination. Those who cannot provide proof of vaccination must submit to the airline they are travelling with a negative PCR (nucleic acid) test report taken within 72 hours before entering Nicaragua. It is also advisable, after buying an air ticket, to ask the airline or travel agency about completing the entry application form in advance. Those entering by land must also first complete the application form online on the immigration authority's website (https://solicitudes.migob.gob.ni).

NL.summary_zh: 荷蘭政府已取消COVID-19入境檢疫相關措施(請參考https://www.government.nl/topics/coronavirus-covid-19/visiting-the-netherlands-from-abroad)。
NL.summary_en: The Dutch government has abolished COVID-19 entry and quarantine measures (please refer to https://www.government.nl/topics/coronavirus-covid-19/visiting-the-netherlands-from-abroad).

NO.summary_zh: 挪威邊境管制措施請參考挪威移民局網站:https://www.udi.no/en/corona/about-the-corona-situation/#link-29572
NO.summary_en: For Norway's border control measures, please refer to the website of the Norwegian Directorate of Immigration: https://www.udi.no/en/corona/about-the-corona-situation/#link-29572

NP.summary_zh: 尼泊爾與中國簽有刑事司法互助協定。另尼泊爾新任總理上任後,政府持續加強取締違法及貪污等不法行為,並對違反移民、簽證及其他相關法令之案件從嚴查處。籲請國人前往尼泊爾旅遊期間,務必遵守當地法令及簽證相關規定,切勿從事與簽證目的不符或其他違法、不正當活動,並提高警覺,慎防遭不法人士詐騙、利用或誘使從事違法行為,以免衍生法律責任或蒙受人身及財產損失。
NP.summary_en: Nepal has signed a mutual legal assistance agreement in criminal matters with China. In addition, since Nepal's new prime minister took office, the government has continued to step up enforcement against unlawful acts such as corruption, and is dealing strictly with cases that violate immigration, visa and other related laws and regulations. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Nepal are urged to comply with local laws and visa regulations at all times, not to engage in activities inconsistent with the purpose of their visa or in other unlawful or improper activities, and to stay alert against being defrauded, exploited or induced into unlawful acts by criminals, so as to avoid legal liability or personal injury and financial loss.

NR.summary_zh: 我國於2024年1月15日宣布與諾魯終止外交關係,持我國護照前往諾魯之入境規定尚待諾魯政府更新,建議國人近期暫勿前往。
NR.summary_en: On 15 January 2024, Taiwan announced the termination of diplomatic relations with Nauru. The entry requirements for holders of Taiwanese passports travelling to Nauru are still awaiting an update by the Nauruan government, and Taiwanese nationals are advised not to travel to Nauru for the time being.

NU.summary_zh: 每年11至4月為熱帶氣旋季節(cyclone season),請留意當地天氣變化及治安情形;倘從事水上活動應特別注意人身安全。旅客倘有身體不適情形,請即撥打24小時專線4100向Niue Foou Hospital尋求協助。
NU.summary_en: The tropical cyclone season (cyclone season) runs from November to April each year. Please keep track of local weather changes and public security conditions; those taking part in water activities should take special care for their personal safety. Travellers who feel unwell should immediately call the 24-hour hotline 4100 to seek assistance from Niue Foou Hospital.

NZ.summary_zh: 紐西蘭政府已取消COVID-19入境檢疫相關管制措施,惟航空或郵輪業者仍可能要求疫苗接種證明,請赴紐旅客先行諮詢所搭乘航空公司或郵輪。另入境後倘有疑似症狀應立即檢驗並建議自我隔離至少5天,請參考官方網站: https://info.health.nz/conditions-treatments/infectious-diseases/covid-19/if-you-have-covid-19 。
NZ.summary_en: The New Zealand government has abolished COVID-19 entry and quarantine controls, but airlines or cruise operators may still require proof of vaccination; travellers to New Zealand should first consult the airline or cruise line they will be using. After arrival, anyone with suspected symptoms should test immediately and is advised to self-isolate for at least 5 days. Please refer to the official website: https://info.health.nz/conditions-treatments/infectious-diseases/covid-19/if-you-have-covid-19 .

OM.summary_zh: 美國及以色列於本(2026)年2月28日對伊朗發動空襲,伊朗隨即進行反擊,攻擊美軍在中東地區軍事基地,範圍並已擴至區域多國民間設施 ,3月1日伊朗對阿曼Duqm港發動無人機攻擊。因中東區域安全情勢急劇惡化,為確保國人安全,即日起將阿曼全境之旅遊警示調整為「橙色」。外交部呼籲國人密切注意區域情勢發展,旅阿曼國人務請提高警覺,留意阿曼政府資訊,以維護個人權益及生命財產安全。
OM.summary_en: On 28 February this year (2026), the United States and Israel launched airstrikes on Iran, and Iran immediately retaliated by attacking US military bases in the Middle East; the attacks have expanded to civilian facilities in several countries in the region. On 1 March, Iran launched a drone attack on Oman's Port of Duqm. As the regional security situation in the Middle East has deteriorated sharply, to ensure the safety of Taiwanese nationals, the travel alert for the whole of Oman is raised to "Orange" with immediate effect. MOFA calls on Taiwanese nationals to closely follow developments in the region; Taiwanese nationals in Oman are asked to stay alert and follow information from the Omani government, in order to safeguard their personal rights and their lives and property.

PA.summary_zh: 巴拿馬衛生部列為管制通報之疾病包括茲卡病毒、屈公病、瘧疾、百日咳、登革熱、黃熱病、利什曼病及傷寒等,多與蚊蟲叮咬有關;另Bocas del Toro、Chiriquí、Colón、Darién、Guna Yala、Ngäbe Buglé、Panama、Veraguas等省份及自治區有感染間日瘧之風險,外交部建議國人赴巴拿馬前備妥適當防蚊及防疫措施,並請醫師評估是否需備口服預防藥物或施打疫苗,倘在當地停留期間出現不明發燒等症狀,應立即就…
PA.summary_en: Diseases designated for mandatory reporting by Panama's Ministry of Health include Zika virus, chikungunya, malaria, pertussis (whooping cough), dengue fever, yellow fever, leishmaniasis and typhoid fever, many of them related to mosquito bites. In addition, there is a risk of infection with Plasmodium vivax malaria in the provinces and indigenous comarcas of Bocas del Toro, Chiriquí, Colón, Darién, Guna Yala, Ngäbe Buglé, Panama and Veraguas. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to prepare appropriate mosquito-protection and disease-prevention measures before travelling to Panama, and to ask a doctor to assess whether oral preventive medication or vaccination is needed. If symptoms such as an unexplained fever appear during the stay, seek medical attention immediately...

PE.summary_zh: 秘魯沿海各省近期受聖嬰現象(El Niño)影響出現強降雨,多處發生嚴重水患及土石流。秘魯政府宣布全國25省中的14省進入第四級(次高級)緊急狀態,包括亞馬遜省(Amazonas)、安卡什省(Áncash)、阿雷基帕省(Arequipa)、卡哈馬卡省(Cajamarca)、伊卡省(Ica)、胡寧省(Junín)、拉利伯塔德省(La Libertad)、蘭巴耶克省(Lambayeque)、利馬省(Lima)、馬德雷德迪奧斯省(Madre…
PE.summary_en: Coastal provinces of Peru have recently experienced heavy rainfall under the influence of El Niño, with serious flooding and landslides in many places. The Peruvian government has declared a Level 4 (second-highest level) state of emergency in 14 of the country's 25 provinces, including Amazonas, Áncash, Arequipa, Cajamarca, Ica, Junín, La Libertad, Lambayeque, Lima and Madre de Dios...

PF.name_zh: 法屬玻里尼西亞(大溪地)
PF.summary_zh: 法屬波里尼西亞已取消COVID-19疫情相關入境及檢疫規定。
PF.summary_en: French Polynesia has abolished its COVID-19-related entry and quarantine rules.

PG.summary_zh: 巴紐國家防疫中心於2022年10月6日宣布,解除一切COVID-19入境限制,國際旅客搭機前免提供COVID-19疫苗接種證明,抵達後免檢測、免隔離,在飛機上及機場內均免戴口罩。
PG.summary_en: On 6 October 2022, Papua New Guinea's National Pandemic Response announced the lifting of all COVID-19 entry restrictions. International travellers no longer need to provide proof of COVID-19 vaccination before boarding, and there is no testing or quarantine on arrival, nor is a mask required on the aircraft or at the airport.

PH.summary_zh: 駐菲律賓代表處近期接獲多起曾在菲從事離岸博奕產業相關工作國人,持菲國政府核發有效簽證入境菲律賓後,即遭扣留護照並限制離境案件。依照菲國政府目前規定,有相關工作經驗國人,若要再度前往菲國,即便已經取得簽證,仍應在入境前,先委託代辦或律師向菲律賓移民局確認是否遭列入「觀察名單」或其他限制名單內,避免抵菲後因名單移除作業滯留菲國。國人倘遭列入,需自行或委託律師向菲律賓移民局申請移除,菲律賓移民局將就個案審酌入境目的及合理性,倘無疑慮,會將當…

areas.area_zh: 民答那峨島
areas.summary_zh: 菲律賓南部民答那峨島(Mindanao)馬拉威(Marawi)市一所大學體育館內,於2023年12月發生炸彈攻擊造成人員傷亡事件,考量該地區恐怖主義活動尚存、治安堪慮,外交部建議國人避免非必要旅行,並提高警覺,以維護人身安全。
areas.summary_en: In December 2023, a bomb attack inside a university gymnasium in Marawi City, Mindanao, in the southern Philippines, caused casualties. Given that terrorist activity persists in the area and public security is a concern, MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid non-essential travel and to stay alert to safeguard their personal safety.

PH.summary_en: The Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in the Philippines has recently received several cases in which Taiwanese nationals who previously worked in the offshore gaming industry in the Philippines had their passports confiscated and were barred from leaving the country after entering the Philippines on valid visas issued by the Philippine government. Under the Philippine government's current rules, Taiwanese nationals with such work experience who wish to travel to the Philippines again, even if they have obtained a visa, should before entering the country first have an agent or lawyer check with the Philippine Bureau of Immigration whether they have been placed on a "watch list" or other restricted list, to avoid being stranded in the Philippines after arrival while waiting to be removed from a list. Those who are listed must apply to the Philippine Bureau of Immigration, themselves or through a lawyer, to be removed; the Bureau will consider the purpose and reasonableness of entry case by case, and if there are no concerns, will remove the person from the list...

PK.summary_zh: 2025年4月22日在喀什米爾(Kashmir)地區印度控制範圍內之旅遊景點巴哈甘(Pahalgam)發生槍擊事件,造成至少26名遊客死亡,印度指控巴基斯坦在背後支持此事件,巴國否認。印巴隨即相互驅逐外交官、暫停核發簽證、關閉邊界過境點,雙方軍隊並在喀什米爾邊境地帶交火,造成多人傷亡,兩國衝突引起國際高度關注。
PK.summary_en: On 22 April 2025, a shooting occurred at the tourist site of Pahalgam in the Indian-administered part of the Kashmir region, killing at least 26 tourists. India accused Pakistan of backing the incident, which Pakistan denied. India and Pakistan promptly expelled each other's diplomats, suspended visa issuance and closed border crossing points, and their armed forces exchanged fire along the Kashmir border area, causing multiple casualties. The conflict between the two countries has attracted great international attention.

PL.summary_zh: 依據波蘭內政部2020年3月13日公布規定,波蘭對俄羅斯及白俄羅斯實施邊境管制,自俄羅斯(包含加里寧格勒)或白俄羅斯以陸路、海路或航空器入境波蘭者,須具備波蘭公民身分、持工作許可或於波蘭就學等要件。
PL.summary_en: Under Poland's Ministry of the Interior rules announced on 13 March 2020, Poland has imposed border controls on Russia and Belarus. Persons entering Poland from Russia (including Kaliningrad) or Belarus by land, sea or aircraft must meet requirements such as having Polish citizenship, holding a work permit, or studying in Poland.

PR.summary_zh: 美屬波多黎各依美國疾病管制暨預防中心(CDC)入境規定,美東時間2023年1月5日起,自中國、香港及澳門地區飛往美國航班之2歲(含2歲)以上各國籍旅客,皆須出示登機前2天內之COVID-19病毒性檢測(viral test)陰性證明或康復證明;上述規定亦適用於經韓國仁川國際機場、多倫多皮爾遜國際機場及溫哥華國際機場轉機且登機前10天內曾停留中國之2歲(含2歲)以上各國籍旅客。此外,所有前往美國之旅客仍須提供14天前已完整接種疫苗的證明…
PR.summary_en: Under the entry requirements of the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) that apply to Puerto Rico, a US territory, from 5 January 2023 (US Eastern Time), all travellers aged 2 and above, of any nationality, on flights to the United States from China, Hong Kong and Macao must present a negative COVID-19 viral test result taken within 2 days before boarding, or documentation of recovery. These rules also apply to travellers aged 2 and above, of any nationality, who transit via Incheon International Airport in South Korea, Toronto Pearson International Airport or Vancouver International Airport and who stayed in China within 10 days before boarding. In addition, all travellers to the United States must still provide proof of having been fully vaccinated at least 14 days earlier...

areas.area_zh: 加薩走廊
areas.summary_zh: 加薩走廊與以色列邊界仍受以軍重兵封鎖,情勢仍不定。外交部建議國人不宜前往加薩走廊商旅,應儘速離境。
areas.summary_en: The border between the Gaza Strip and Israel remains under heavy blockade by Israeli forces, and the situation remains uncertain. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals not to travel to the Gaza Strip for business or leisure, and to leave as soon as possible.

areas.area_zh: 約旦河西岸地區
areas.summary_zh: 以色列軍警對巴勒斯坦-約旦河西岸各地城市高度管控,且不時封鎖邊關。外交部建議國人不宜前往約旦河西岸地區商旅,應儘速離境。
areas.summary_en: Israeli military and police maintain tight control over cities across the Palestinian West Bank and from time to time close border crossings. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals not to travel to the West Bank for business or leisure, and to leave as soon as possible.

PT.summary_zh: 請國人在規劃葡萄牙行程時,仍事先洽詢航空公司及參考國際航空運輸協會網頁資訊(www.iatatravelcentre.com/world.php),以瞭解轉機及入境有否最新的規定(也包含天候異常現象是否影響航班運作等情況),旅行期間請隨時注意個人安全與衛生健康。
PT.summary_en: When planning trips to Portugal, Taiwanese nationals are asked to still check in advance with the airline and refer to the International Air Transport Association (IATA) website (www.iatatravelcentre.com/world.php) to learn of the latest transit and entry rules (including whether abnormal weather is affecting flight operations). Please pay attention to your personal safety and health at all times during the trip.

PW.summary_zh: 近來帛琉諾羅病毒頻發導致國人發生急性症狀,建議國人赴帛旅遊前事先關注自身身體狀況及投保旅遊平安/意外/醫療等保險,帛琉醫療資源有限,當地設有公立帛琉國家醫院(電話+680-488-2552)及Belau Medical Clinic私立診所(電話+680488-2688),惟處理急重症經驗侷限,建議國人隨時注意自身健康安危。
PW.summary_en: Norovirus has recently broken out frequently in Palau, causing acute symptoms among Taiwanese nationals. Taiwanese nationals are advised to pay attention to their own physical condition and to take out travel accident/medical and other insurance before travelling to Palau. Medical resources in Palau are limited; there are the public Belau National Hospital (tel. +680-488-2552) and the private Belau Medical Clinic (tel. +680488-2688), but their experience in handling acute and severe cases is limited, so Taiwanese nationals are advised to watch their health and safety at all times.

PY.summary_zh: 巴國為登革熱及屈公病流行地區,請國人做好防蚊措施,倘出現發燒、關節痛、頭痛、噁心、嘔吐、疲倦、肌肉疼痛或皮疹等症狀,請儘早就醫治療。
PY.summary_en: Paraguay is an area where dengue fever and chikungunya are epidemic. Taiwanese nationals should take mosquito-protection measures, and if symptoms such as fever, joint pain, headache, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, muscle pain or rash appear, seek medical treatment as early as possible.

QA.summary_zh: 鑒於中東區域情勢持續動盪,為確保國人安全,卡達全境之旅遊警示維持為「橙色」。外交部呼籲國人密切注意區域情勢發展,旅卡國人務請提高警覺,留意卡達政府資訊,以維護個人權益及生命財產安全。
QA.summary_en: In view of the continuing turmoil in the Middle East, to ensure the safety of Taiwanese nationals, the travel alert for the whole of Qatar remains "Orange". MOFA calls on Taiwanese nationals to closely follow developments in the region; Taiwanese nationals in Qatar are asked to stay alert and follow information from the Qatari government, in order to safeguard their personal rights and their lives and property.

RE.summary_zh: 法屬留尼旺島治安尚稱良好。公共衛生方面,該島曾發生屈公病疫情,近期仍有零星病例通報。此病主要透過蚊蟲叮咬傳播,常見症狀包括發燒、皮疹及關節疼痛。建議避免前往積水及蚊蟲孳生處,並於清晨及傍晚蚊蟲活躍時段加強防護,使用防蚊用品以降低感染風險。如需緊急醫療援助,請撥打112。相關訊息請參考衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁( https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
RE.summary_en: Public security on French Reunion Island is considered good. In terms of public health, the island has experienced a chikungunya outbreak, and sporadic cases are still being reported recently. The disease is spread mainly by mosquito bites, and common symptoms include fever, rash and joint pain. Taiwanese nationals are advised to avoid places with standing water and mosquito breeding sites, to step up protection in the early morning and evening when mosquitoes are active, and to use mosquito repellent to reduce the risk of infection. For urgent medical assistance, call 112. For related information, please refer to the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (https://www.cdc.gov.tw).

RO.summary_zh: 外交部提醒國人赴歐洲旅遊前務必購買海外急難救助及足額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間內自身的安全與權益;行前並與親友或雇主洽妥國際匯款方式,以備即時獲得濟助。旅遊期間務必小心自身護照及身分證件及錢財,倘護照或錢財遭竊,請立即向當地警察局報案。
RO.summary_en: MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals to be sure to buy overseas emergency assistance and adequate medical insurance before travelling to Europe, to safeguard their safety and rights during the trip. Before departure, also arrange with family, friends or employers how to receive international remittances, so that help can be obtained promptly. During the trip, take great care of your passport, identity documents and money; if your passport or money is stolen, report it to the local police immediately.

RS.summary_zh: 塞爾維亞近來大規模示威活動頻繁,或可能影響交通運輸,提醒有規劃前往塞爾維亞旅行之國人除須事先辦妥塞爾維亞簽證外,並應隨時注意當地新聞,確認行程是否受到影響,同時提醒國人宜注意當地治安,提高警覺,注意自身安全。
RS.summary_en: Large-scale protests have recently been frequent in Serbia and may affect transport. Taiwanese nationals planning to travel to Serbia are reminded that, besides obtaining a Serbian visa in advance, they should keep following local news at all times to confirm whether their itinerary is affected. They are also reminded to be mindful of local public security, stay alert and take care of their own safety.

RU.summary_zh: 莫斯科本(115)年6月18日凌晨起遭受數波無人機攻擊迄今,情勢有升高趨勢,造成能源基礎設施嚴重毀損,且波及住宅區造成平民傷亡。請在俄國人外出注意安全,並避免前往能源基礎設施、鄰近軍事設施之地區及人群聚集等場域。
RU.summary_en: Since the early hours of 18 June this year (ROC year 115, i.e. 2026), Moscow has been hit by several waves of drone attacks, and the situation is escalating, causing serious damage to energy infrastructure and civilian casualties in residential areas. Taiwanese nationals in Russia are asked to take care when going out, and to avoid areas near energy infrastructure and military facilities, and crowded places.

RW.summary_zh: 非洲疾病管制暨預防中心(Africa CDC)於2026年5月23日提出警告,除剛果民主共和國及烏干達外,盧安達等10國亦面臨伊波拉病毒擴散風險,國人若在當地,應採取加強防護措施。欲查詢盧安達相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
RW.summary_en: On 23 May 2026, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) issued a warning that, in addition to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, 10 countries including Rwanda also face the risk of Ebola virus spread. Taiwanese nationals who are in the country should take enhanced protective measures. For information on the epidemic and communicable disease prevention in Rwanda, please refer to the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw).

SA.summary_zh: 自本年10月6日起,葉門胡塞組織(Houthis)持續對沙國發動飛彈及無人機攻擊,目標集中於包括首都利雅德等機場設施,並已造成人員傷亡。因中東區域情勢持續動盪,為確保國人安全,外交部呼籲國人密切注意區域情勢發展,並建議國人暫時避免前往利雅德哈立德國王國際機場及周邊地區、減少非必要外出,並留意沙國政府公布的最新資訊,以維護個人權益及生命財產安全。

areas.area_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯 - 沙國與葉門邊界地區納季蘭
areas.area_en: Saudi Arabia - Border regions with Yemen (Najran)
areas.summary_zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯與葉門接壤之納季蘭(Najran)及其他邊境地區持續有武裝衝突、飛彈及無人機攻擊風險,邊境道路或口岸亦可能因安全情勢臨時管制或關閉。為維護國人權益及生命財產安全,本區旅遊警示調升為「紅色」,外交部籲請國人儘速離境,並密切注意區域情勢及沙國政府發布之安全資訊。
areas.summary_en: Najran and other border areas of Saudi Arabia adjoining Yemen continue to face the risk of armed clashes and missile and drone attacks, and border roads or crossing points may be temporarily restricted or closed because of the security situation. To safeguard the rights and the lives and property of Taiwanese nationals, the travel alert for this area is raised to "Red". MOFA urges Taiwanese nationals to leave as soon as possible, and to closely follow the regional situation and the security information released by the Saudi government.

SA.summary_en: Since 6 October this year, the Houthis of Yemen have continued to launch missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, with targets concentrated on facilities including airports in the capital, Riyadh, and have caused casualties. As the situation in the Middle East remains turbulent, to ensure the safety of Taiwanese nationals, MOFA calls on Taiwanese nationals to closely follow developments in the region, and advises them to temporarily avoid King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and surrounding areas, to reduce non-essential outings, and to follow the latest information released by the Saudi government, in order to safeguard their personal rights and their lives and property.

SB.summary_zh: 索羅門群島衛生部於2022年10月11日更新COVID-19入境管制措施,僅要求所有12歲以上國際旅客須完成二劑疫苗施打,第二劑疫苗並須於入境4週前完成;12歲以下倘未完成疫苗接種,須出示72小時內PCR檢測陰性報告。
SB.summary_en: On 11 October 2022, the Solomon Islands Ministry of Health updated its COVID-19 entry control measures, requiring only that all international travellers aged 12 and above have completed two doses of vaccine, with the second dose completed at least 4 weeks before entry; those under 12 who have not completed vaccination must present a negative PCR test report taken within 72 hours.

SC.summary_zh: 塞國治安尚可,但針對遊客行竊或搶劫仍時有所聞,國人如赴當地旅遊宜避免單獨行動,並隨時注意自身安全。
SC.summary_en: Public security in Seychelles is acceptable, but thefts and robberies targeting tourists are still reported from time to time. Taiwanese nationals travelling there are advised to avoid going about alone and to stay mindful of their own safety at all times.

SD.summary_zh: 2023年4月15日蘇丹政府軍與當地武裝勢力「快速支援部隊」(RSF)爆發軍事衝突,內戰持續至今,RSF於2025年10月攻陷蘇丹政府軍在西部達佛地區(Darfur)最後據點法舍市(El-Fasher),該國政治局勢與安全持續惡化,內戰至今已造成數十萬人死亡及數百萬人流離失所。
SD.summary_en: On 15 April 2023, military conflict broke out between the Sudanese government army and the local armed group, the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), and the civil war continues to this day. In October 2025, the RSF captured El-Fasher, the government army's last stronghold in the western Darfur region. The country's political situation and security continue to deteriorate, and the civil war has so far caused several hundred thousand deaths and displaced millions of people.

SE.summary_zh: 瑞典邊境入出境管制相關規範請詳瑞典警察署:https://polisen.se/en/laws-and-regulations/travel-to-and-stay-in-sweden/border-control/
SE.summary_en: For Sweden's border entry and exit control rules, please refer to the Swedish Police Authority: https://polisen.se/en/laws-and-regulations/travel-to-and-stay-in-sweden/border-control/

SG.summary_zh: 自2023年2月13日起,所有來新加坡的短期旅客,無論有無施打COVID-19疫苗,均不須要強制購買旅遊保險,亦無須出示登機前陰性檢測證明或疫苗接種證明,入境新加坡後免檢測、免隔離,可自由活動。
SG.summary_en: Starting 13 February 2023, all short-term travellers coming to Singapore, whether or not they have been vaccinated against COVID-19, are no longer required to buy travel insurance, nor to present a negative pre-departure test result or proof of vaccination. There is no testing or quarantine after entering Singapore, and travellers may move about freely.

SI.summary_zh: 國人來歐旅遊,常因護照與錢包放在一起保管遭竊,除了財物損失之外也造成後續旅遊行程延誤。另國人出國旅遊常有各種意想不到的情況發生,遇到生病或受傷時可能需要住院治療,由於遊客在斯洛維尼亞自費醫療金額高昂,加護病房每日單價動輒高達數千歐元。
SI.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling in Europe often have their passports stolen because they keep them together with their wallets, which causes not only the loss of belongings but also delays to the rest of the trip. In addition, all kinds of unexpected situations often arise when Taiwanese nationals travel abroad, and illness or injury may require hospitalisation. Because self-paid medical costs for tourists in Slovenia are very high, the cost of intensive care alone can reach several thousand euros per day.

SK.summary_zh: 外交部提醒國人赴歐洲旅遊前務必購買海外急難救助及足額醫療保險,保障旅遊期間自身的安全與權益;行前並與親友或雇主洽妥國際匯款方式,以備即時獲得濟助。旅遊期間務必小心自身護照及身分證件及錢財,倘護照或錢財遭竊,請立即向當地警察局報案。
SK.summary_en: MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals to be sure to buy overseas emergency assistance and adequate medical insurance before travelling to Europe, to safeguard their safety and rights during the trip. Before departure, also arrange with family, friends or employers how to receive international remittances, so that help can be obtained promptly. During the trip, take great care of your passport, identity documents and money; if your passport or money is stolen, report it to the local police immediately.

SL.summary_zh: 獅子山於2025年1月因境內出現首例M痘(Mpox)病例並宣布公共衛生緊急狀態後,近期病例急遽以每週超過300例之惡化情勢陡增加,且自本年5月初之累計通報1,140例,激增至目前2,648例;死亡數亦自9例累計至14例,持續佔極高之西部非洲病例與死亡總數比率。世界衛生組織(WHO)雖已儘速提供該國數萬餘劑疫苗進行相關接種,但惡化情勢暫難以解除。
SL.summary_en: After Sierra Leone declared a public health emergency in January 2025 upon its first mpox case, cases have recently surged as the situation worsens at a rate of more than 300 cases per week, and cumulative reported cases have jumped from 1,140 in early May this year to 2,648 now; deaths have also risen cumulatively from 9 to 14, and the country continues to account for a very high share of total cases and deaths in West Africa. Although the World Health Organization (WHO) has promptly supplied the country with tens of thousands of vaccine doses for vaccination, the worsening situation is unlikely to ease for the time being.

SM.summary_zh: 我國人持中華民國(臺灣)護照(效期6個月以上)享有180天內免簽證入境包括聖馬利諾之申根區觀光旅遊90天待遇,免簽證入境待遇係供短期觀光商旅之用,倘須工作應向聖馬利諾當局申辦工作許可,並請留意切勿從事非法工作及違反當地法令。
SM.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals holding a Republic of China (Taiwan) passport valid for at least 6 months enjoy visa-free entry for tourism, including to San Marino, for up to 90 days within any 180-day period in the Schengen Area. Visa-free entry is intended for short-term tourism and business trips. Those who need to work must apply to the San Marino authorities for a work permit, and should take care not to engage in illegal work or violate local laws and regulations.

SN.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人,且塞國支持「一中原則」,與中國已簽署「刑事司法互助協定」及「引渡協定」,中國有權向該國申請法律協助或引渡逃犯。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
SN.summary_en: China will implement the "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" from 1 July 2026, under which "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine ethnic unity and progress in China or commit acts of ethnic separatism will be held legally liable according to law". This is an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction and threatens Taiwanese nationals abroad. Senegal supports the "One China principle" and has signed a "mutual legal assistance agreement in criminal matters" and an "extradition agreement" with China, so China has the right to request legal assistance or the extradition of fugitives from that country. Taiwanese nationals are reminded, when travelling for business or staying abroad, to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them, to safeguard their own rights and personal safety.

SO.summary_zh: 索馬利亞全境恐怖攻擊、武裝衝突、暴力犯罪與綁架事件頻傳,首都摩加迪休(Mogadishu)於2022年10月29日在市區交通要道發生2起汽車炸彈爆炸攻擊事件,造成超過1百人死亡,數百人受傷,安全局勢進一步緊張惡化。
SO.summary_en: Terrorist attacks, armed conflict, violent crime and kidnappings are frequent throughout Somalia. On 29 October 2022, two car bomb attacks occurred on major roads in the capital, Mogadishu, killing more than 100 people and injuring hundreds, further worsening the tense security situation.

SR.summary_zh: 蘇利南首都與旅遊熱區常見扒竊、搶劫等事件,建議國人旅遊時應注意財物及自身安全,並避免出入複雜場所與夜間獨行,倘有緊急狀況可聯繫蘇國警方,電話為115。
SR.summary_en: Pickpocketing, robbery and similar incidents are common in Suriname's capital and popular tourist areas. Taiwanese nationals travelling there are advised to take care of their belongings and personal safety, avoid complicated places and walking alone at night, and, in an emergency, contact the Surinamese police on 115.

SS.summary_zh: 非洲聯盟(African Union)下屬之非洲疾病管制暨預防中心(Africa CDC)於2026年5月23日警告,除剛果民主共和國與烏干達外,另有10個非洲國家面臨伊波拉病毒擴散風險,其中包含南蘇丹。國人若在當地,應採取加強防護措施並儘速離境。欲查詢相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
SS.summary_en: On 23 May 2026, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) under the African Union warned that, in addition to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, 10 other African countries face the risk of Ebola virus spread, including South Sudan. Taiwanese nationals who are in the country should take enhanced protective measures and leave as soon as possible. For information on the epidemic and communicable disease prevention, please refer to the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw).

ST.summary_zh: 請國人在規劃聖多美普林西比行程時,仍事先洽詢航空公司或參考國際航空運輸協會網頁資訊( https:// www.iatatravelcentre.com/world.php ),以瞭解轉機及入境有否最新的規定(也包含天候異常現象是否影響航班運作等情況),旅行期間請隨時注意個人安全與衛生健康。
ST.summary_en: When planning trips to Sao Tome and Principe, Taiwanese nationals are asked to still check in advance with the airline or refer to the International Air Transport Association (IATA) website (https://www.iatatravelcentre.com/world.php) to learn of the latest transit and entry rules (including whether abnormal weather is affecting flight operations). Please pay attention to your personal safety and health at all times during the trip.

SV.summary_zh: 國人赴薩爾瓦多可依觀光、就學、商務、國際交流及醫療等事由,申請至多停留180天之簽證。薩國目前將我國移除於電子簽證適用國,薩國移民局官網線上申辦電子簽證系統雖開放我國人提出申請,惟仍將因資格不符遭駁回且無法申請退款,請國人注意前往薩國前應先向薩國駐外使領館洽詢並以紙本方式申辦簽證。
SV.summary_en: Taiwanese nationals travelling to El Salvador can apply for a visa of up to 180 days' stay for reasons such as tourism, study, business, international exchange and medical treatment. El Salvador has currently removed Taiwan from the list of countries eligible for the electronic visa. Although the online e-visa system on the website of El Salvador's immigration authority is open for Taiwanese nationals to submit applications, they will still be rejected for ineligibility and the fee cannot be refunded. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to first consult a Salvadoran embassy or consulate abroad before travelling to El Salvador and to apply for a visa in paper form.

SY.summary_zh: 敘利亞新政府於2024年12月成立後仍處於過渡時期,境內面臨治安不佳、恐怖攻擊、教派與族群衝突等問題,安全情勢仍極不穩定,呼籲國人勿前往敘利亞,旅居該地區者應考慮離境。
SY.summary_en: Syria's new government, established in December 2024, is still in a transitional period, and the country faces problems such as poor public security, terrorist attacks, and sectarian and ethnic conflict. The security situation remains extremely unstable. MOFA calls on Taiwanese nationals not to travel to Syria, and those residing there should consider leaving.

SZ.name_zh: 史瓦帝尼王國(原史瓦濟蘭王國)
SZ.summary_zh: 史國治安大致良好,惟仍有少數搶劫及偷竊案發生,籲請國人赴史商旅時提高警覺,注意自身安全。
SZ.summary_en: Public security in Eswatini is generally good, but a small number of robberies and thefts still occur. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Eswatini for business or leisure are urged to stay alert and take care of their own safety.

TC.summary_zh: 土克凱可群島政府宣布至2023年3月31日前,滿18歲之旅客應出示入境14天前已完整接種COVID-19疫苗之相關證明。
TC.summary_en: The government of the Turks and Caicos Islands has announced that, until 31 March 2023, travellers aged 18 and above must present proof of full COVID-19 vaccination completed at least 14 days before entry.

TD.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
TD.summary_en: China's "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" takes effect on 1 July 2026. It states that "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine China's ethnic unity and progress or engage in ethnic separatism will be held legally liable in accordance with the law", an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction that threatens foreign nationals outside China. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying overseas, in order to protect their own rights and personal safety.

TG.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。
TG.summary_en: China's "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" takes effect on 1 July 2026. It states that "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine China's ethnic unity and progress or engage in ethnic separatism will be held legally liable in accordance with the law", an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction that threatens foreign nationals outside China. Taiwanese nationals are reminded to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them while travelling or staying overseas, in order to protect their own rights and personal safety.

TH.summary_zh: 鑒於泰柬邊境衝突再度升溫,泰國政府已撤離邊境地區人民,外交部持續提醒近期擬赴泰國的國人務必留意自身安全,應避免前往旅遊警示為橙色警示之烏汶府(Ubon Ratchathani)、四色菊府(Si Saket)、素林府(Surin)、武里喃府(Buriram)、沙繳府(Sa Kaeo)、達勒府(Trat)及尖竹汶府(Chanthaburi),並請隨時注意泰國當局發布的最新消息,留意周遭環境、人身及財務安全。

areas.area_zh: 泰國烏汶府(Ubon Ratchathani)、四色菊府(Si Saket)、素林府(Surin)、武里喃府(Buriram)、沙繳府(Sa Kaeo)、達勒府(Trat)及尖竹汶府(Chanthaburi)
areas.summary_zh: 鑒於泰柬邊境衝突再度升溫,泰國政府已撤離邊境地區人民,外交部再度呼籲國人應避免前往泰柬邊境50公里內的烏汶府(Ubon Ratchathani)、四色菊府(Si Saket)、素林府(Surin)、武里喃府 (Buriram)、沙繳府(Sa Kaeo)、達勒府(Trat)及尖竹汶府(Chanthaburi)等地區觀光或非必要旅行,倘因故仍須前往,請於出國前至外交部領事事務局「旅外國人動態登錄」網頁(網址: https://www.bo…
areas.summary_en: In view of the renewed escalation of the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict, the Thai government has evacuated people from the border areas. MOFA once again calls on Taiwanese nationals to avoid travelling for tourism or non-essential purposes to areas within 50 kilometres of the Thailand-Cambodia border, including Ubon Ratchathani, Si Saket, Surin, Buriram, Sa Kaeo, Trat and Chanthaburi provinces. Those who must still go for some reason should, before leaving Taiwan, register on the "Registration for Taiwanese Nationals Travelling Abroad" web page of the Bureau of Consular Affairs, MOFA (URL: https://www.bo...

TH.summary_en: In view of the renewed escalation of the Thailand-Cambodia border conflict, the Thai government has evacuated people from the border areas. MOFA continues to remind Taiwanese nationals planning to travel to Thailand in the near term to take care of their safety, and to avoid Ubon Ratchathani, Si Saket, Surin, Buriram, Sa Kaeo, Trat and Chanthaburi provinces, which are under an Orange travel alert. Please also keep following the latest announcements from the Thai authorities and stay mindful of your surroundings and your personal and financial safety.

TJ.summary_zh: 塔吉克政府已取消入境限制措施,外國公民入境塔國無須出示COVID-19核酸檢測陰性報告或疫苗接種證明,亦無須隔離。

areas.area_zh: 塔吉克與阿富汗、吉爾吉斯及烏茲別克接壤邊界地區
areas.area_en: The border regions with Afghanistan, the Kyrgyz Republic and Uzbekistan
areas.summary_zh: 由於目前阿富汗政治局勢仍不穩定,塔吉克與阿富汗接壤地區安全狀況堪虞,且塔國與吉爾吉斯邊界多年來武裝衝突不斷,雙方目前雖已協議停火,邊境仍有出現零星衝突可能,國人赴塔國商旅須保持警覺,並避免前往邊境地區。
areas.summary_en: As the political situation in Afghanistan remains unstable, the security situation in areas of Tajikistan bordering Afghanistan is a concern. In addition, armed clashes have continued for many years along the border between Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan. Although the two sides have now agreed to a ceasefire, sporadic clashes at the border remain possible. Taiwanese nationals travelling to Tajikistan for business or leisure must stay alert and avoid border areas.

TJ.summary_en: The Tajik government has lifted its entry restrictions. Foreign nationals entering Tajikistan are no longer required to present a negative COVID-19 nucleic acid test report or proof of vaccination, nor to quarantine.

TL.summary_zh: 東帝汶醫療資源匱乏,東國境內出現零星狂犬病病例;另外如瘧疾、登革熱、病毒性腸胃炎等盛行,宜審慎考量旅行必要性並做好準備。
TL.summary_en: Medical resources in Timor-Leste are scarce, and sporadic rabies cases have occurred in the country. In addition, diseases such as malaria, dengue fever and viral gastroenteritis are prevalent. Taiwanese nationals should carefully consider whether travel is necessary and make good preparations.

TM.summary_zh: 土庫曼政府已取消COVID-19疫情相關入境限制措施。
TM.summary_en: The Turkmen government has abolished its COVID-19-related entry restrictions.

TN.summary_zh: 中國於2026年7月1日起實施「民族團結進步促進法」,「針對中國境外的組織和個人,破壞中國民族團結進步、製造民族分裂行為者,將會被依法追究法律責任」,企圖將跨境管轄合法化,威脅境外國人,且突國支持「一中原則」,與中國已簽署「刑事司法互助協定」及「引渡協定」,中國有權向該國申請法律協助或引渡逃犯,中國有權向該國申請法律協助或引渡逃犯。提醒國人海外商旅或停留期間,宜注意相關法規動態與衍生之潛在風險,以維護自身權益及人身安全。

areas.area_zh: 突尼西亞中西部山區及與阿爾及利亞及利比亞邊界地區
areas.area_en: Mountainous areas of central-western Tunisia and border areas with Algeria and Libya
areas.summary_zh: 突尼西亞接壤阿爾及利亞及利比亞之邊界地帶因嚴重安全問題長期有突國軍隊派駐,無突國當局許可不得前往。中西部Chambi、Selloum、Mghila、Orbata及Semema山區常有恐怖份子藏匿,故常有反恐軍事行動,請國人非必要切勿前往。
areas.summary_en: Because of serious security problems, Tunisian troops have long been stationed in the border zones where Tunisia adjoins Algeria and Libya, and no one may go there without permission from the Tunisian authorities. Terrorists often hide in the mountain areas of Chambi, Selloum, Mghila, Orbata and Semema in the centre-west, so counter-terrorism military operations are frequent there. Taiwanese nationals are asked not to go unless it is essential.

TN.summary_en: China will implement the "Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress" from 1 July 2026, under which "organisations and individuals outside China who undermine ethnic unity and progress in China or commit acts of ethnic separatism will be held legally liable according to law". This is an attempt to legitimise cross-border jurisdiction and threatens Taiwanese nationals abroad. Tunisia supports the "One China principle" and has signed a "mutual legal assistance agreement in criminal matters" and an "extradition agreement" with China, so China has the right to request legal assistance or the extradition of fugitives from that country. Taiwanese nationals are reminded, when travelling for business or staying abroad, to pay attention to developments in the relevant laws and regulations and the potential risks arising from them, to safeguard their own rights and personal safety.

TO.summary_zh: 東加已取消COVID-19 疫情相關入境及檢疫規定。
TO.summary_en: Tonga has lifted its COVID-19-related entry and quarantine requirements.

TR.summary_zh: 伊朗針對美國及以色列於2026年2月28日發動空襲後進行大規模反擊,戰火波及中東多國,鑒於美國、以色列及伊朗衝突尚未停歇,外交部即日起將土耳其旅遊警示自灰色調整為「黃色」,籲請在土耳其國人密切注意情勢發展,短期內暫時避免前往土國東部與東南部地區,如遇飛彈、無人機或火箭攻擊事件,請立即尋找遮蔽物並就地避險,並與我駐土耳其代表處保持聯繫。

areas.area_zh: 土耳其東南部省份與敘利亞交界10公里內區域
areas.area_en: Areas within 10 km of Türkiye- southeastern provinces bordering Syria
areas.summary_zh: 伊朗針對美國及以色列於2026年2月28日發動空襲後進行大規模反擊,戰火波及中東多國,土耳其國防部於3月4日公告,部署於東地中海的北約防空與飛彈防禦系統已攔截一枚自伊朗發射經伊拉克與敘利亞領空並飛往土耳其的彈道飛彈,飛彈碎片落在土國南部邊界省分Hatay省,幸未造成人員傷亡。鑒於中東情勢持續惡化,並已波及土耳其南部邊界省份,為確保旅土國人安全,即日起將「土耳其東南部省份與敘利亞交界10公里內區域」旅遊警示燈號自橙色調升至「紅色」。
areas.summary_en: Iran launched large-scale retaliation after the United States and Israel carried out airstrikes on 28 February 2026, and the fighting has spread to several countries in the Middle East. On 4 March, Türkiye's Ministry of National Defence announced that NATO air and missile defence systems deployed in the eastern Mediterranean had intercepted a ballistic missile launched from Iran that flew through Iraqi and Syrian airspace toward Türkiye; missile debris fell in Hatay Province on Türkiye's southern border, fortunately without casualties. As the situation in the Middle East continues to worsen and has now affected Türkiye's southern border provinces, MOFA is, effective today, raising the travel alert for "the area within 10 kilometres of the Syrian border in southeastern Türkiye" from Orange to "Red" to ensure the safety of Taiwanese nationals in Türkiye.

TR.summary_en: Iran launched large-scale retaliation after the United States and Israel carried out airstrikes on 28 February 2026, and the fighting has spread to several countries in the Middle East. As the conflict among the United States, Israel and Iran has not abated, MOFA is, effective today, raising the travel alert for Türkiye from Gray to "Yellow". MOFA urges Taiwanese nationals in Türkiye to pay close attention to developments, to temporarily avoid travelling to eastern and southeastern Türkiye in the short term, to seek cover immediately and take shelter in place in the event of a missile, drone or rocket attack, and to stay in contact with the Taiwan representative office in Türkiye.

TT.summary_zh: 千里達首都與旅遊熱區常見暴力犯罪,提醒國人避免夜間外出及進出複雜場所,另建議國人旅遊時應注意財物及自身安全,防範竊盜及汽車破窗行竊等犯罪活動,倘有緊急狀況可聯繫千國警方,電話為999。
TT.summary_en: Violent crime is common in Trinidad and Tobago's capital and popular tourist areas. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals to avoid going out at night and to avoid entering disreputable or crowded venues. It also advises Taiwanese nationals to watch their belongings and personal safety while travelling and to guard against theft and car break-ins (smashing windows to steal items). In an emergency, contact the Trinidad and Tobago police at 999.

TV.summary_zh: 吐瓦魯國於本(2025)年6月初爆發登革熱疫情,至8月底截止,全國計有131個確診病例,在吐京以外的吐國8大島中,Nanumaga係唯一出現確診病例的外島。所幸目前吐國未傳出因染疫死亡案例,疫情尚在可控範圍內。
TV.summary_en: Tuvalu experienced a dengue outbreak beginning in early June of this year (2025). As of the end of August, the country had recorded 131 confirmed cases; among the eight islands outside the capital, Nanumaga is the only outer island with confirmed cases. Fortunately, no deaths from the infection have been reported in Tuvalu so far, and the outbreak remains under control.

TZ.summary_zh: 非洲聯盟(African Union)下屬之非洲疾病管制暨預防中心(Africa CDC)於2026年5月23日警告,除剛果民主共和國與烏干達外,另有10個非洲國家面臨伊波拉病毒擴散風險,其中包含坦尚尼亞。國人若在當地,應採取加強防護措施。欲查詢相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。

areas.area_zh: 坦尚尼亞(Tanzania)南部姆特瓦拉(Mtwara)、林迪(Lindi)、魯伍馬(Ruvuma)三省區及西部卡蓋拉(Kagera)及基戈馬(Kigoma)兩省區
areas.area_en: Mtwara, Lindi and Ruvuma regions in southern Tanzania and Kagera and Kigoma regions in western Tanzania
areas.summary_zh: 坦尚尼亞南部鄰接莫三比克邊界之主要產油區姆特瓦拉(Mtwara)、林迪(Lindi)及魯伍馬(Ruvuma)三省區因伊斯蘭國莫三比克分部之恐佈分子常跨境活動,造成威脅,請勿前往。此外,坦尚尼亞西部鄰近蒲隆地之卡蓋拉(Kagera)及基戈馬(Kigoma)兩省區因安全情勢不穩,建議避免前往該等地區,以策安全。
areas.summary_en: Do not travel to the three provinces/regions of Mtwara, Lindi and Ruvuma, the main oil-producing areas in southern Tanzania bordering Mozambique, which are threatened by terrorists of the Islamic State Mozambique Province who frequently operate across the border. In addition, because of the unstable security situation, MOFA advises avoiding the two provinces/regions of Kagera and Kigoma in western Tanzania, near Burundi, for safety.

TZ.summary_en: On 23 May 2026, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) of the African Union warned that, besides the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, 10 other African countries, including Tanzania, face a risk of Ebola virus spread. Taiwanese nationals who are in the country should take enhanced protective measures. For information on the outbreak and infectious disease prevention, please refer to the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw ).

UA.summary_zh: 俄羅斯於本(2026)年3月23日至24日對烏克蘭發動開戰以來最大規模空襲,遠離東部戰線之西部重鎮利沃夫市等地亦遭波及。目前俄烏持續交戰中,烏國各大城市及相關基礎建設仍頻遭俄國不定時大規模空襲。
UA.summary_en: On 23-24 March this year (2026), Russia carried out its largest air raid on Ukraine since the war began, which also hit places such as the western city of Lviv, far from the eastern front. Russia and Ukraine are still at war, and Ukraine's major cities and related infrastructure continue to be hit by large-scale Russian air raids at irregular intervals.

UG.summary_zh: 肯亞日前發現有史以來首宗[自剛果(金夏沙)經烏干達]境外移入之伊波拉感染死亡病例,肯亞伊波拉案例波及烏干達,建議國人盡量避免赴烏干達,旅居烏干達之台商、僑民及我國籍觀光客請遵守防疫措施,盡量避免與人肢體接觸及參加葬禮,以維護健康安全。
UG.summary_en: Kenya recently identified its first-ever fatal Ebola case imported from outside the country [from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) via Uganda]; the Kenyan Ebola case has affected Uganda. Taiwanese nationals are advised to avoid travel to Uganda as far as possible. Taiwanese businesspeople, expatriates and Taiwanese tourists in Uganda should follow disease prevention measures and avoid physical contact and attending funerals as far as possible, to protect their health and safety.

US.summary_zh: 美國地區近來持續發生許多有關電話、簡訊、求職及網路購物等詐騙案件,受害人數逐年攀升,常見詐騙手法包括冒充中共警察、偽稱快遞包裹未取、冒充美國稅局通知退稅或欠稅、求職錄取簡訊通知等詐騙案件。提醒旅美國人及留學生提高警覺,若接到不尋常電話,請保持冷靜及查明真偽,勿輕易提供護照、身分證與銀行帳戶等個資,並切勿按照來路不明指示進行匯款或轉帳等。倘民眾遭遇網路詐騙、投資詐騙、身份竊用、或任何涉及金錢損失的犯罪,應立即向所在地警察局報案,以便警方…

areas.area_zh: 美國-夏威夷州
areas.summary_zh: 2026年8月中旬侵襲夏州各島之颶風Lala造成全州各地停水、逾20萬戶停電數日至2週以上之久。
areas.summary_en: Hurricane Lala, which struck the islands of Hawaii in mid-August 2026, caused water outages across the state and power outages affecting more than 200,000 customers for several days to over two weeks.

areas.area_zh: 美國 - 南加州
areas.summary_zh: 南加州地區近來頻繁發生砸破車窗竊盜案件,歹徒鎖定停放於停車場或路邊的車輛,伺機砸破車窗後竊取車內財物。
areas.summary_en: Car window smash-and-grab thefts have recently been occurring frequently in Southern California. Criminals target vehicles parked in car parks or on the roadside and wait for an opportunity to smash the windows and steal items from inside.

areas.area_zh: 美國 - 紐約
areas.summary_zh: 根據紐約市警察局最新公布之統計資料,2025年1月至10月間,紐約市犯案數累計99,904起,較上年同期下降約3.5%。除性犯罪案件增加外,其餘各類犯罪型態件數均較2024年同期減少。然紐約各地仍不乏遊行及示威活動,請國人務必提高警覺並注意自身安全。
areas.summary_en: According to the latest statistics released by the New York City Police Department, from January to October 2025 New York City recorded a cumulative 99,904 crimes, about 3.5% fewer than in the same period of the previous year. Apart from an increase in sex crimes, the number of cases in every other type of crime was lower than in the same period of 2024. However, there are still many parades and demonstrations across New York, and Taiwanese nationals are urged to stay vigilant and pay attention to their personal safety.

areas.area_zh: 美國-南加州地區、亞利桑那州及新墨西哥州
areas.area_en: United States - Southern California, Arizona and New Mexico
areas.summary_zh: 一. 自2025年1月7日以來,大洛杉磯地區連續發生多處野火延燒,包括Palisades, Kenneth, Archer, Greek, Sunset, Eaton, Hurst及 Lidia等地,外交部提醒國人倘前往南加州旅遊,宜先查明目的地最新資訊,同時注意自身安全並避免前往災區。洛杉磯地區長期空汙嚴重,呼吸道敏感者建議酌配戴口罩,以維持健康。
areas.summary_en: 1. Since 7 January 2025, wildfires have been burning continuously in multiple locations across the Greater Los Angeles area, including Palisades, Kenneth, Archer, Greek, Sunset, Eaton, Hurst and Lidia. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals travelling to Southern California to first check the latest information on their destination, to pay attention to their own safety, and to avoid the disaster areas. Los Angeles has long suffered serious air pollution, and those with sensitive airways are advised to wear a mask where appropriate to maintain their health.

areas.area_zh: 美國-大紐約地區
areas.area_en: United States - Greater New York area
areas.summary_zh: 依據美國疾病管制局(CDC)2025年9月統計,大紐約地區流感疫情大致獲得控制,除紐約州感染成長預測值為6.3%之外,紐澤西州、賓州與康乃狄克州的感染預測值均低於1%。雖然流感疫情獲得控制,但由於美國醫療費用極為高昂,提醒國人在行前應購妥醫療保險或海外旅遊意外險。
areas.summary_en: According to September 2025 statistics from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the influenza outbreak in the Greater New York area has been largely brought under control: apart from New York State, where the projected infection growth is 6.3%, the projected infection rates in New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Connecticut are all below 1%. Although the flu outbreak is under control, medical costs in the United States are extremely high, so MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals to purchase medical insurance or overseas travel accident insurance before departure.

areas.area_zh: 喬治亞、北卡羅萊納、南卡羅萊納、田納西、阿拉巴馬及肯塔基等6州
areas.area_en: Six states: Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Alabama and Kentucky

areas.area_zh: 維吉尼亞州西南部
美國 - 關島

US.summary_en: Many scams involving phone calls, text messages, job offers and online shopping have recently continued to occur in the United States, with the number of victims rising year by year. Common scam tactics include impersonating Chinese (PRC) police, falsely claiming that a courier package was not collected, impersonating the U.S. tax authority to announce a tax refund or tax owed, and fake job-offer text messages. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals and students in the United States to stay alert. If you receive an unusual call, stay calm and verify its authenticity; do not readily provide personal information such as your passport, ID card or bank account details, and never remit or transfer money following instructions from unknown sources. If you encounter online fraud, investment fraud, identity theft, or any crime involving financial loss, report it immediately to the local police so that the police can...

UY.summary_zh: 烏拉圭政府要求我國人申請烏拉圭簽證需檢附刑事紀錄證明文件(良民證)。
UY.summary_en: The Uruguayan government requires Taiwanese nationals applying for a Uruguayan visa to submit a criminal record certificate (police clearance certificate).

UZ.summary_zh: 烏茲別克政府已取消入境限制措施,外國公民入境烏國無須出示COVID-19核酸檢測陰性報告或疫苗接種證明,亦無須隔離。
UZ.summary_en: The Uzbek government has lifted its entry restrictions. Foreign nationals entering Uzbekistan are no longer required to present a negative COVID-19 nucleic acid test report or proof of vaccination, nor to quarantine.

VA.summary_zh: 夏季暑休期間,梵蒂岡觀光景點人潮眾多,提醒國人隨時提高警覺,注意保管隨身物品,並妥善保存護照。護照正本應妥善收存,建議僅攜少額現金及信用卡即可,以降低風險。參觀梵蒂岡博物館等旅遊景點,請事先於官方網站預約購票,並確實配合遵守相關規範。
VA.summary_en: During the summer holiday period, tourist attractions in Vatican City are crowded. MOFA reminds Taiwanese nationals to stay alert at all times, keep a close watch on their belongings, and keep their passports safe. Keep your original passport in a safe place; it is recommended to carry only a small amount of cash and a credit card to reduce risk. To visit attractions such as the Vatican Museums, please book tickets in advance on the official website and strictly comply with the relevant rules.

VC.summary_zh: 聖文森及格瑞那丁治安尚可,惟偶有槍擊事件,首都與旅遊熱區竊盜案較多,建議國人旅遊時注意財物及自身安全,並避免出入複雜場所與夜間獨行,倘有緊急狀況可聯繫聖國警方,電話為911。
VC.summary_en: Public security in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is fair, but shootings occasionally occur, and theft is relatively common in the capital and popular tourist areas. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to watch their belongings and personal safety while travelling, and to avoid disreputable or crowded venues and walking alone at night. In an emergency, contact the Saint Vincent and the Grenadines police at 911.

VE.summary_zh: 美國於2026年1月3日對委內瑞拉實施軍事打擊,委內瑞拉政府已宣布全國進入緊急狀態,部分地區停電,大眾交通運輸工具多數停擺,未來局勢不明,外交部建議國人非必要請勿前往,倘在委國境內請儘速離境。
VE.summary_en: The United States carried out military strikes on Venezuela on 3 January 2026. The Venezuelan government has declared a nationwide state of emergency, power outages have occurred in some areas, and most public transport has come to a halt. The situation going forward is uncertain. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals not to travel to Venezuela unless essential, and those already in Venezuela should leave the country as soon as possible.

VG.summary_zh: 加勒比海地區6月至11月為颶風季節(hurricane season),英屬維京群島領土較小,大雨恐造成土石流,切斷周遭社區與外界交通聯繫,請國人赴當地商務及旅遊務必隨時注意天氣預報,倘遭遇天災請依照當地政府指示避難,並聯繫我駐聖克里斯多福及尼維斯大使館提供必要協助。
VG.summary_en: June to November is hurricane season in the Caribbean. The British Virgin Islands is a small territory, and heavy rain may cause landslides that cut surrounding communities off from the outside world. Taiwanese nationals travelling there for business or tourism must keep checking weather forecasts at all times. In the event of a natural disaster, please follow the instructions of the local government to take shelter, and contact the Embassy of Taiwan in Saint Kitts and Nevis for necessary assistance.

VI.summary_zh: 美屬維京群島依美國疾病管制暨預防中心(CDC)入境規定,美東時間2023年1月5日起,自中國、香港及澳門地區飛往美國航班之2歲(含2歲)以上各國籍旅客,皆須出示登機前2天內之COVID-19病毒性檢測(viral test)陰性證明或康復證明;上述規定亦適用於經韓國仁川國際機場、多倫多皮爾遜國際機場及溫哥華國際機場轉機且登機前10天內曾停留中國之2歲(含2歲)以上各國籍旅客。此外,所有前往美國之旅客仍須提供14天前已完整接種疫苗的證明…
VI.summary_en: Under the entry requirements of the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) that apply to the U.S. Virgin Islands, from 5 January 2023 (U.S. Eastern Time), all passengers aged 2 and above, of any nationality, on flights to the United States from China, Hong Kong and Macao must present a negative COVID-19 viral test result taken within 2 days before boarding or documentation of recovery. These requirements also apply to passengers aged 2 and above, of any nationality, who transit via Incheon International Airport in South Korea, Toronto Pearson International Airport or Vancouver International Airport and who stayed in China within 10 days before boarding. In addition, all travellers to the United States must still provide proof of full vaccination received at least 14 days earlier...

VN.summary_zh: 越南政府自2023年8月15日起開放所有國家/地區申請赴越電子簽證,其中適用對象包含我國,越南電子簽證最長停留時間為90天,單次入境收費25美元,多次入境收費50美元,申請工作日3至7天,申請網址: https://evisa.gov.vn/ 。
VN.summary_en: From 15 August 2023, the Vietnamese government has opened e-visa applications for travel to Vietnam to all countries and regions, including Taiwan. The Vietnam e-visa allows a maximum stay of 90 days and costs US$25 for single entry and US$50 for multiple entry, with a processing time of 3 to 7 working days. Application website: https://evisa.gov.vn/ .

VU.summary_zh: 萬那杜2024年12月發生規模7級以上強震,首府建築物及基礎設施受損嚴重,至今仍待恢復,物資短缺,治安仍持續惡化中。
VU.summary_en: A strong earthquake of magnitude 7 or above struck Vanuatu in December 2024. Buildings and infrastructure in the capital were severely damaged and have still not been restored, supplies are short, and public security continues to deteriorate.

WF.name_zh: 瓦利斯群島和富圖那群島
WF.summary_zh: 法屬瓦利斯和富圖那群島已取消COVID-19疫情相關入境及檢疫規定。
WF.summary_en: Wallis and Futuna (France) has lifted its COVID-19-related entry and quarantine requirements.

WS.summary_zh: 薩摩亞緊急向國外採購及租用發電機,現已回復供應電力,惟近期政局不穩,民心浮動,恐有零星騷亂發生。
WS.summary_en: Samoa urgently purchased and rented generators from abroad, and electricity supply has now been restored. However, owing to the recent political instability and public unease, sporadic unrest may occur.

XK.summary_zh: 科索沃國絕大部分地區治安穩定,但北部Mitrovica、Leposavic、Zubin Potok以及Zvecan等地容易發生阿爾巴尼亞族與塞爾維亞族社群衝突,致引發科國與塞國政治情勢緊張。如有必要前往,建議隨時注意當地新聞資訊,以確保旅遊時自身安全,並請避免涉入任何政治活動。
XK.summary_en: Public security is stable in the vast majority of Kosovo. However, in the north, places such as Mitrovica, Leposavic, Zubin Potok and Zvecan are prone to clashes between the Albanian and Serbian communities, which have caused political tensions between Kosovo and Serbia. If you must travel there, MOFA advises keeping up with local news at all times to ensure your own safety, and avoiding involvement in any political activity.

YE.summary_zh: 鑒於葉門境內武裝衝突、飛彈及無人機攻擊等風險持續,葉門全境旅遊警示維持為「紅色」。外交部籲請國人勿前往葉門;已在葉門境內之國人,應在確認交通及路線安全可行後儘速離境。
YE.summary_en: In view of the continuing risks of armed conflict, missile attacks and drone attacks in Yemen, the travel alert for the whole of Yemen remains "Red". MOFA urges Taiwanese nationals not to travel to Yemen; Taiwanese nationals already in Yemen should leave as soon as possible once they have confirmed that transport and routes are safe and feasible.

YT.summary_zh: 法屬馬約特島部分地區偶有治安事件發生,建議國人避免前往治安不佳或人潮複雜區域,夜間減少單獨外出,並隨時提高警覺,以確保人身及財物安全。
YT.summary_en: Security incidents occasionally occur in some parts of Mayotte (France). MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid areas with poor public security or crowded areas, to go out alone less at night, and to stay alert at all times to ensure their personal and property safety.

ZA.summary_zh: 南非許多地區近期時有示威、抗議及罷工活動,可能影響交通、運輸及各項公共服務,並有迅速演變為暴力衝突之風險。建議國人行前密切關注當地輿情與新聞動態,並儘量避免前往或途經人群聚集之地區,以確保自身安全。

areas.area_zh: 開普敦
areas.summary_zh: 南非境內治安持續不靖,除公路詐騙、槍擊、搶劫、竊盜案外,亦有針對等待紅燈之汽車砸窗搶奪車內財物、自天橋朝行進間車輛投擲石塊,俟受害人停車查看時洗劫財物、誘騙路人至ATM取款,及在開普敦國際機場冒充Uber司機或計程車兜客坐地起價或盜刷信用卡等情形。
areas.summary_en: Public security in South Africa remains poor. Besides highway scams, shootings, robberies and thefts, there are also cases of windows of cars waiting at red lights being smashed to snatch items from inside; stones being thrown from overpasses at moving vehicles, with victims robbed after they stop to check; passers-by being lured to ATMs to withdraw cash; and, at Cape Town International Airport, people posing as Uber drivers or touting for taxis who overcharge or fraudulently use credit cards.

ZA.summary_en: Demonstrations, protests and strikes have recently occurred from time to time in many parts of South Africa, which may disrupt traffic, transport and various public services and may quickly turn into violent clashes. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to closely follow local public opinion and news before travelling and to avoid, as far as possible, going to or passing through places where crowds gather, to ensure their own safety.

ZM.summary_zh: 非洲聯盟(African Union)下屬之非洲疾病管制暨預防中心(Africa CDC)於2026年5月23日警告,除剛果民主共和國與烏干達外,另有10個非洲國家面臨伊波拉病毒擴散風險,其中包含尚比亞。國人若在當地,應採取加強防護措施。欲查詢相關疫情及傳染病防治資訊,請參閱衛生福利部疾病管制署網頁(網址: https://www.cdc.gov.tw )。
ZM.summary_en: On 23 May 2026, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) of the African Union warned that, besides the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, 10 other African countries, including Zambia, face a risk of Ebola virus spread. Taiwanese nationals who are in the country should take enhanced protective measures. For information on the outbreak and infectious disease prevention, please refer to the website of the Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare (URL: https://www.cdc.gov.tw ).

ZW.summary_zh: 辛巴威衛生環境及水質均欠佳,時見霍亂(cholera)等傳染病流行,外交部建議國人避免前往辛巴威商旅;倘因故需前往辛巴威,應多加留意健康,並注意將自來水先煮沸後再飲用,確保飲用水衛生,勤加洗手。另辛巴威曾爆發小兒麻痺疫情,籲請國人前往該國前諮詢專業醫生意見進行預防接種。
ZW.summary_en: Hygiene and water quality in Zimbabwe are poor, and infectious diseases such as cholera are often epidemic. MOFA advises Taiwanese nationals to avoid travelling to Zimbabwe for business or tourism. If you must go to Zimbabwe, pay close attention to your health, boil tap water before drinking it to ensure safe drinking water, and wash your hands frequently. In addition, Zimbabwe has experienced a polio outbreak, and Taiwanese nationals are urged to consult a medical professional about vaccination before travelling to the country.

mofa.area_zh: 義大利北部米蘭(Milano)、杜林(Torino)及波隆納(Bologna)等城市
